title: Accelerating crystal structure prediction by machine-learning interatomic potentials with active learning
summary: Moment-tensor machine-learning potentials trained by active learning replace most DFT calculations in evolutionary crystal structure prediction

title: An autonomous laboratory for the accelerated synthesis of inorganic materials
summary: The A-Lab combines computed stability data, machine learning, and robotics to plan and run solid-state syntheses of inorganic targets autonomously

title: Accelerating inverse materials design using generative diffusion models with reinforcement learning
summary: MatInvent optimizes crystal diffusion models with reinforcement learning, using property predictors as rewards, and reaches target property values within about 60 iterations (about 1,000 property evaluations)

title: A generative model for inorganic materials design
summary: MatterGen is a diffusion model for inorganic crystals that can be steered toward target chemistry, symmetry, and property constraints

title: High-throughput study of electrical conductivity in ordered metals
summary: ML combined with high-throughput ab initio calculations screens over 2.8 million compounds for metallic transport; full electron-phonon calculations on the top candidates agree with available experiments and identify conductors such as LiBePt2 approaching the conductivity of aluminium

title: Benchmarking materials property prediction methods: the Matbench test set and Automatminer reference algorithm
summary: Matbench v0.1: 13 supervised tasks (312 to 132k samples; composition and structure inputs) with nested CV, plus the Automatminer baseline.

title: A critical examination of compound stability predictions from machine-learned formation energies
summary: Shows low formation-energy MAE does not imply accurate stability (decomposition energy) prediction for compositional ML models.

title: Is Domain Knowledge Necessary for Machine Learning Materials Properties?
summary: Compares domain-knowledge featurization with learned representations for composition-based property prediction.

title: Benchmarking graph neural networks for materials chemistry
summary: MatDeepLearn benchmarks several GNNs (CGCNN, MEGNet, SchNet, MPNN, GCN) on bulk, surface, 2D and cluster datasets under a common framework.

title: A critical examination of robustness and generalizability of machine learning prediction of materials properties
summary: Finds ML models trained on Materials Project 2018 degrade on newer 2021 data, highlighting distribution-shift issues.

title: Examining graph neural networks for crystal structures: Limitations and opportunities for capturing periodicity
summary: Analyzes GNN failure to capture periodicity and shows hybrid descriptor-GNN models improve Matbench-type tasks.

title: MatSci-NLP: Evaluating Scientific Language Models on Materials Science Language Tasks Using Text-to-Schema Modeling
summary: MatSci-NLP: benchmark of 7 materials-science NLP tasks for evaluating language models.

title: JARVIS-Leaderboard: a large scale benchmark of materials design methods
summary: Community leaderboard spanning AI, electronic structure, force fields, quantum computation and experiments (274 benchmarks and 1281 contributions at publication).

title: Structure-based out-of-distribution (OOD) materials property prediction: a benchmark study
summary: Benchmarks GNN property models on OOD splits of Matbench-derived tasks, finding marked degradation versus random splits.

title: MaScQA: investigating materials science knowledge of large language models
summary: 650 materials-science exam questions to evaluate LLM knowledge and reasoning.

title: A framework to evaluate machine learning crystal stability predictions
summary: Matbench Discovery: prospective benchmark on ~257k WBM structures evaluating stability classification (F1, DAF), energy regression, and kappa_SRME thermal conductivity.

title: MLIP Arena: Advancing Fairness and Transparency in Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials via an Open, Accessible Benchmark Platform
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38
summary: Open benchmark platform evaluating MLIPs on physical-consistency tasks (diatomics, EOS, MD stability, phonons, NEB, elasticity) beyond DFT-error metrics.

title: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials are ready for phonons
summary: Benchmarks universal MLIPs on harmonic phonons of ~10k materials from the MDR phonon database.

title: Systematic softening in universal machine learning interatomic potentials
summary: Shows universal MLIPs systematically underestimate PES curvature (surface energies, phonons, defects) and that fine-tuning corrects it.

title: LLM4Mat-bench: benchmarking large language models for materials property prediction
summary: Largest LLM property benchmark: ~1.9M crystals from 10 sources and 45 properties with composition, CIF and text inputs.

title: Migration as a Probe: A Generalizable Benchmark Framework for Specialist vs. Generalist Machine-Learned Force Fields
summary: Benchmarks specialist, fine-tuned and foundation MLFFs using defect-migration NEB pathways in Cr-doped Sb2Te3 as interpolation and extrapolation probes.

subcategory: thermal conductivity: uMLIP force-constant and kappa_L benchmark
title: A Comprehensive Assessment and Benchmark Study of Large Atomistic Foundation Models for Phonons
summary: Benchmarks EquiformerV2, MatterSim, MACE and CHGNet on second/third-order force constants and kappa_L for 2,429 OQMD crystals, finding fine-tuned EquiformerV2 (OMat24) best while MACE and CHGNet give poor kappa_L despite similar force errors, so force accuracy alone does not predict kappa_L accuracy

subcategory: ionic conductivity: migration-barrier dataset and GNN/uMLIP benchmark
title: Benchmarking machine learning models for predicting lithium ion migration
summary: The LiTraj dataset (13,000 percolation barriers, 122,000 empirical-force-field migration barriers and 1,700 DFT migration trajectories) shows that structure-to-barrier GNNs can separate fast from poor Li conductors and that fine-tuned uMLIPs reach near-DFT accuracy on NEB migration barriers.

subcategory: thermal conductivity: kappa SRME benchmark for foundation MLIPs
title: Thermal conductivity predictions with foundation atomistic models
summary: Defines the symmetric relative (mean) errors SRE/SRME on per-phonon Wigner conductivity contributions and Grueneisen parameters for 103 phononDB-PBE solids, benchmarks M3GNet, CHGNet, MACE-MP-0, SevenNet and ORB, and shows fine-tuning MACE on three DFT frames brings LiBr kappa within 2% of DFT

subcategory: thermal conductivity: surrogate kappa_L regressor benchmark
title: Fast and accurate prediction of lattice thermal conductivity via machine learning surrogates
summary: Benchmarks 15 kappa_L surrogates (physics descriptors plus ML, end-to-end GNNs, and pretrained-MLIP embeddings plus ML) on 6,966 Phonix entries under random, space-group-disjoint and out-of-distribution splits, finding MLIP-embedding models best for interpolation and the ALiEGNN network most robust out of distribution

subcategory: ionic conductivity: uMLIP benchmark for barriers and diffusivity
title: Benchmarking Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Alkali-Ion Battery Kinetics
summary: Benchmarks M3GNet, CHGNet, MatterSim, MACE, SevenNet, GRACE and Orb against DFT on cathodes and solid electrolytes: Orb-v3 gives the best static migration barriers (MAE about 75 to 111 meV), GRACE-OMat24 best reproduces MD diffusivities, and high-temperature non-equilibrium training data matter more for kinetic accuracy than architecture.

subcategory: ionic conductivity: uMLIP-MD vs AIMD against experiment
title: A Comparative Study of Molecular Dynamics Approaches for Simulating Ionic Conductivity in Solid Lithium Electrolytes
summary: Benchmarks MD-computed ionic conductivity for 21 Li solid electrolytes with experimental reference values and finds a MACE foundation model comparable to DFT-driven MD in accuracy while running more than 350 times faster on one GPU than DFT on a 64-CPU node.

subcategory: uncertainty: calibration under shift and active learning
title: When active learning fails, uncalibrated out of distribution uncertainty quantification might be the problem
summary: Compares ALIGNN deep ensembles, loss-landscape uncertainties and XGBoost/random-forest/NN ensembles on bandgap, formation energy and solubility, finding that recalibration fitted in-domain generalizes inconsistently out of domain and that calibrated uncertainties generally fail to beat random sampling or uncalibrated uncertainties in OOD active learning.

title: AFLOW: An automatic framework for high-throughput materials discovery
summary: Presents the AFLOW high-throughput framework and associated AFLOWLIB repository of DFT-computed materials properties.

title: Commentary: The Materials Project: A materials genome approach to accelerating materials innovation
summary: Introduces the Materials Project, an open high-throughput DFT database of inorganic compounds (now >150k materials) widely used as an ML training source.

title: Materials Design and Discovery with High-Throughput Density Functional Theory: The Open Quantum Materials Database (OQMD)
summary: Introduces the OQMD, a high-throughput DFT database of formation energies for hundreds of thousands of inorganic compounds.

title: The Open Quantum Materials Database (OQMD): assessing the accuracy of DFT formation energies
summary: Describes OQMD growth to ~300k compounds and benchmarks its DFT formation energies against experiment.

title: The AFLOW standard for high-throughput materials science calculations
summary: Defines the standardized calculation parameters underlying AFLOW database entries, enabling consistent ML training data.

title: Charting the complete elastic properties of inorganic crystalline compounds
summary: Full elastic tensors for 1,181 inorganic compounds computed in Materials Project; basis of elastic-moduli ML tasks.

title: A database to enable discovery and design of piezoelectric materials
summary: DFPT piezoelectric tensors for 941 inorganic compounds in Materials Project.

subcategory: data quality: DFT reproducibility across codes
title: Reproducibility in density functional theory calculations of solids
summary: Community Delta test comparing 15 solid-state DFT codes and 40 potential/basis-set types on PBE equations of state for 71 elemental crystals, finding that recent codes agree to within differences comparable to those between high-precision experiments, while older methods agree less well.

title: An ab initio electronic transport database for inorganic materials
summary: BoltzTraP constant-relaxation-time transport tensors (conductivity, Seebeck coefficient, effective mass) for about 48,000 Materials Project compounds, at publication the largest computed electronic-transport database and a standard label source for transport ML.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: DFPT dielectric database
title: High-throughput screening of inorganic compounds for the discovery of novel dielectric and optical materials
summary: A DFPT database of dielectric tensors and refractive indices for 1,056 compounds, then the largest available and integrated into the Materials Project, which seeded later ML models of epsilon and n.

title: NOMAD: The FAIR concept for big data-driven materials science
summary: Describes the NOMAD repository and FAIR data principles for the largest archive of raw computational materials data.

title: The Computational 2D Materials Database: high-throughput modeling and discovery of atomically thin crystals
summary: C2DB: high-throughput DFT/GW properties for thousands of 2D materials.

title: Predicting the Band Gaps of Inorganic Solids by Machine Learning
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
summary: Curates ~6k experimental band gaps of inorganic solids (basis of Matbench expt_gap) and trains composition-based SVR models.

title: Matminer: An open source toolkit for materials data mining
summary: Matminer provides dataset loaders (incl. dozens of curated datasets) and featurizers for materials ML.

title: The NOMAD laboratory: from data sharing to artificial intelligence
summary: Overview of the NOMAD Laboratory: repository, archive, encyclopedia and AI toolkit for materials data.

subcategory: data quality: anthropogenic and selection bias
title: Anthropogenic biases in chemical reaction data hinder exploratory inorganic synthesis
summary: Shows that reported amine-templated metal oxide syntheses follow a power law (17% of amines appear in 79% of compounds) and, using 548 randomly generated experiments, that reagent popularity is uncorrelated with success and that models trained on a smaller randomized dataset outperform those trained on larger human-selected data.

title: The joint automated repository for various integrated simulations (JARVIS) for data-driven materials design
summary: Describes NIST JARVIS infrastructure (JARVIS-DFT, -FF, -ML, -tools) including the ~55k-entry dft_3d dataset with many properties.

title: High-throughput density functional perturbation theory and machine learning predictions of infrared, piezoelectric, and dielectric responses
summary: JARVIS DFPT dataset of IR, piezoelectric and dielectric responses for thousands of materials, with ML models trained on it.

title: Materials Cloud, a platform for open computational science
summary: Presents Materials Cloud, an open platform sharing AiiDA-provenance computational materials data and curated datasets.

title: The PAULING FILE Project and Materials Platform for Data Science: From Big Data Toward Materials Genome
summary: Describes the PAULING FILE / MPDS curated experimental database of crystal structures, phase diagrams and physical properties.

title: A band-gap database for semiconducting inorganic materials calculated with hybrid functional
summary: HSE hybrid-functional band gap database for ~10k semiconducting inorganic materials.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: ferroelectric polarization database
title: An automatically curated first-principles database of ferroelectrics
summary: A symmetry-driven automated DFT workflow screens over 67,000 Materials Project entries to give 255 ferroelectric candidates (126 newly proposed) with structures, band gaps, energies and spontaneous polarizations benchmarked against experiment.

title: Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20) Dataset and Community Challenges
summary: OC20: ~1.3M DFT relaxations (~265M single points) of adsorbate-surface systems with S2EF/IS2RE/IS2RS tasks and leaderboard.

subcategory: data quality: anthropogenic and selection bias
title: Predicting energy and stability of known and hypothetical crystals using graph neural network
summary: Demonstrates that a GNN trained only on ground-state structures is biased and that a balanced training set (~16,500 NREL MatDB ground-state plus ~11,000 hypothetical higher-energy structures) is needed to rank polymorph energies correctly, with error analysis exposing outliers and occasional inconsistencies in the training data.

title: A dataset of 175k stable and metastable materials calculated with the PBEsol and SCAN functionals
summary: Alexandria-related dataset of 175k materials computed with PBEsol and SCAN functionals for higher-fidelity ML targets.

title: Machine-Learning-Assisted Determination of the Global Zero-Temperature Phase Diagram of Materials
summary: Uses ML-guided high-throughput DFT to build the Alexandria convex hull with millions of calculated compounds.

title: Scaling deep learning for materials discovery
summary: GNoME discovers ~2.2 million new crystals (381k on the convex hull) via active-learning GNNs and releases stable structures.

title: CHGNet as a pretrained universal neural network potential for charge-informed atomistic modelling
summary: Introduces CHGNet and the MPtrj dataset (~1.58M structures from ~146k Materials Project relaxations) with energies, forces, stresses and magmoms.

title: The Open Catalyst 2022 (OC22) Dataset and Challenges for Oxide Electrocatalysts
summary: OC22: ~62k DFT relaxations (~9.8M single points) of oxide surfaces with adsorbates and associated benchmark tasks.

subcategory: data quality: DFT reproducibility across codes
title: How to verify the precision of density-functional-theory implementations via reproducible and universal workflows
summary: Expert recommendation extending the Delta-style verification to Z = 1-96 with 10 cubic unaries and oxides per element, producing 960 all-electron reference equations of state cross-checked between two codes and used to verify and improve nine pseudopotential-based approaches.

title: Quantifying uncertainty in high-throughput density functional theory: A comparison of AFLOW, Materials Project, and OQMD
summary: Pairwise comparison of AFLOW, Materials Project and OQMD records computed from the same initial structures finds disagreement up to 0.105 eV/atom in formation energy, 0.21 eV in band gap and 0.65 A^3/atom in volume (comparable to DFT-experiment differences), with up to 7% of records disagreeing on metallicity and 15% on magnetism, traced to pseudopotential, DFT+U and elemental-reference choices.

title: 3DSC - a dataset of superconductors including crystal structures
summary: 3DSC augments SuperCon Tc data (including tested non-superconductors) with approximate 3D crystal structures and shows in ML experiments that adding structural information improves Tc prediction over composition alone.

title: A database of experimentally measured lithium solid electrolyte conductivities evaluated with machine learning
summary: Curates 820 impedance-measured Li-ion conductivities from 214 sources (403 unique compositions near room temperature) and trains a CrabNet composition-only classifier that labels compositions as high or low conductivity to help experimentalists prioritize candidates.

title: Unveiling the complex structure-property correlation of defects in 2D materials based on high throughput datasets
summary: Introduces the 2D Material Defect (2DMD) DFT datasets of defect properties for MoS2, WSe2, hBN, GaSe, InSe and black phosphorus, together with a platform for applying ML to pristine and defected 2D materials and a data-driven analysis of how defect configurations control their properties.

title: Improving machine-learning models in materials science through large datasets
summary: Releases the expanded Alexandria database (millions of PBE calculations) and shows scaling of GNN property models with data size.

title: Open Materials 2024 (OMat24) Inorganic Materials Dataset and Models
summary: Meta FAIR OMat24 dataset of ~110M DFT calculations on non-equilibrium inorganic structures, with EquiformerV2 models.

title: Learning Superconductivity from Ordered and Disordered Material Structures
summary: Introduces SuperCon3D, pairing experimental Tc values with ordered and disordered ICSD structures, and SODNet, an equivariant model that uses both ordered and disordered structural information to predict Tc.

title: A Foundational Potential Energy Surface Dataset for Materials
summary: MatPES: ~400k carefully sampled structures with PBE and r2SCAN single points for training universal potentials.

title: LeMat-Bulk: aggregating, and de-duplicating quantum chemistry materials databases
summary: LeMaterial's LeMat-Bulk unifies and de-duplicates Materials Project, Alexandria and OQMD into a harmonized multi-million-entry dataset.

subcategory: data quality: experimental data errors and curation
title: Tackling dataset curation challenges towards reliable machine learning: a case study on thermoelectric materials
summary: Using half-Heusler thermoelectrics, documents inaccurate entries in the LLM-assisted Starrydata2 dataset (ambiguous nomenclature, complex formulas, high-variance multi-source values without synthesis information) that conventional curation misses, and proposes a statistical round-robin-error filter plus a hybrid manual/automatic curation workflow.

title: SuperBand: an Electronic-band and Fermi surface structure database of superconductors
summary: SuperBand provides DFT-optimized structures, band structures, DOS and Fermi surfaces for 1,362 superconductors with experimental Tc and 1,112 verified non-superconductors, designed for ML of superconducting properties beyond composition.

title: Dataset of tensorial optical and transport properties of materials from the Wannier function method
summary: A Wannier-function database of tensorial electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity, Seebeck coefficient and zT (plus optical tensors) for 7301 materials, built to enable symmetry-aware ML of anisotropic transport.

subcategory: multimodal: structure + 2D projection images + structured text
title: Beyond Atomic Geometry Representations in Materials Science: A Human-in-the-Loop Multimodal Framework
summary: MultiCrystalSpectrumSet (MCS-Set) augments atomic structures with 2D projections and human-in-the-loop textual annotations for multimodal property and summary prediction, and benchmarks of language and vision-language models reveal substantial modality-specific performance gaps.

title: The Roadmap of Inorganic Computational Materials Databases: Capabilities, Credibility, Coverage, and the Open Frontier
summary: Perspective surveying DFT codes, cost and credibility for nineteen property families and database coverage, concluding that structure, energetics, elasticity and topology are routinely tabulated while nine families (e.g. NMR/EPR parameters, core-level spectra, electron-phonon properties, thermal conductivity, quantum transport) still lack any systematic computational database.

title: An open benchmark for machine learning-based polymer property prediction
summary: PolyBench26 is an open benchmark of nearly 250,000 polymer-property datapoints over eight properties (experiment, DFT, MD) spanning homopolymers and alternating, random and block copolymers, on which graph-based models give the lowest errors across data sizes and repeat-unit complexity.

subcategory: unified database with ML property completion
title: Probing the limits of materials design via a comprehensive crystal database of 14.6 million structures with 140 properties
summary: MateriaViva unifies 55 databases into 14.6 million distinct crystals with over one billion property values, using an equivariant Crystal Graph Transformer Network and 140 property-prediction models to complete missing properties; it finds tens of thousands of overlooked high-performance known materials and shows that 55-100% of inverse-designed structures are not new

title: Machine-accelerated extraction of experimental superconducting parameters for physical insight and prediction across thousands of materials
summary: AutoSuperCon: 20,354 entries of eight experimental superconducting parameters for 6,793 superconductors, extracted from over 47,000 arXiv preprints by a large language model and validated against NIMS SuperCon (R2 = 0.96)

title: Database and deep-learning scalability of anharmonic phonon properties by automated brute-force first-principles calculations
summary: Builds an automated first-principles anharmonic phonon workflow and database of more than 6,500 inorganic compounds, then trains a GNN on structures to predict kappa_L and its spectra, showing that accuracy keeps improving with training-set size and screening for extreme-kappa materials

subcategory: ionic conductivity: experimental Li-conductivity dataset with crystal structures
title: OBELiX: a curated dataset of crystal structures and experimentally measured ionic conductivities for lithium solid-state electrolytes
summary: OBELiX curates 599 synthesized Li solid electrolytes with experimentally measured room-temperature conductivities, composition, space group and lattice parameters (about 320 with full CIFs), provides splits designed to avoid leakage, and benchmarks seven ML models on conductivity regression.

title: Atom-centered symmetry functions for constructing high-dimensional neural network potentials
summary: Defines atom-centered symmetry functions for local atomic environments.

title: Fast and Accurate Modeling of Molecular Atomization Energies with Machine Learning
summary: Introduces the Coulomb matrix representation for ML of molecular atomization energies.

title: On representing chemical environments
summary: Introduces SOAP and compares local atomic environment descriptors.

title: How to represent crystal structures for machine learning: Towards fast prediction of electronic properties
summary: Partial radial distribution function representation for predicting crystal DOS at the Fermi level.

title: Big Data of Materials Science: Critical Role of the Descriptor
summary: Compressed-sensing approach to find physically meaningful descriptors for crystal structure energetics.

title: Crystal structure representations for machine learning models of formation energies
summary: Extends Coulomb-matrix representations (Ewald sum, sine matrix) to periodic crystals.

title: High-Throughput Machine-Learning-Driven Synthesis of Full-Heusler Compounds
summary: Uses composition-derived elemental property descriptors with ML to screen Heusler compounds.

title: Including crystal structure attributes in machine learning models of formation energies via Voronoi tessellations
summary: Voronoi-tessellation-based crystal structure attributes combined with composition features.

title: Universal fragment descriptors for predicting properties of inorganic crystals
summary: Property-labelled materials fragments (PLMF) as universal descriptors for inorganic crystals.

title: Representation of compounds for machine-learning prediction of physical properties
summary: Compositional and structural representations for ML prediction of compound properties.

title: Machine learning reveals orbital interaction in materials
venue: Science and Technology of Advanced Materials
summary: Orbital-field matrix descriptor built from valence-orbital occupations of coordinating atoms.

title: Quantifying similarity of pore-geometry in nanoporous materials
summary: Uses persistent homology to quantify pore-geometry similarity in nanoporous materials.

title: SISSO: A compressed-sensing method for identifying the best low-dimensional descriptor in an immensity of offered candidates
summary: SISSO: sure independence screening and sparsifying operator for descriptor identification.

title: Machine learning with force-field-inspired descriptors for materials: Fast screening and mapping energy landscape
summary: Classical force-field inspired descriptors (CFID) for ML of material properties.

title: New tolerance factor to predict the stability of perovskite oxides and halides
summary: SISSO-derived tolerance factor for predicting perovskite stability.

title: Simultaneous learning of several materials properties from incomplete databases with multi-task SISSO
summary: Multi-task SISSO learning several properties from incomplete databases.

title: Local structure order parameters and site fingerprints for quantification of coordination environment and crystal structure similarity
summary: Local structure order parameters / site fingerprints for coordination environments.

title: DScribe: Library of descriptors for machine learning in materials science
summary: DScribe: library implementing Coulomb matrix, SOAP, ACSF, MBTR and related descriptors.

title: Topological representations of crystalline compounds for the machine-learning prediction of materials properties
summary: Persistent-homology-based topological representations for material property prediction.

title: Machine learning with persistent homology and chemical word embeddings improves prediction accuracy and interpretability in metal-organic frameworks
summary: Combines persistent homology with chemical word embeddings for crystal property prediction.

title: Physics-Inspired Structural Representations for Molecules and Materials
summary: Review of physics-inspired structural representations for atomistic ML.

title: Materials representation and transfer learning for multi-property prediction
summary: Studies materials representations and transfer learning for multi-property prediction.

title: Unified representation of molecules and crystals for machine learning
summary: Many-body tensor representation (MBTR) for molecules and crystals.

title: Average minimum distances of periodic point sets – foundational invariants for mapping periodic crystals
venue: MATCH Communications in Mathematical and in Computer Chemistry
summary: Average minimum distance (AMD) isometry invariants for comparing periodic crystals.

title: The pointwise distance distribution is stronger than the pair distribution function
venue: Acta Crystallographica Section A Foundations and Advances
summary: Shows pointwise distance distributions are a stronger crystal invariant than the pair distribution function.

title: Rapid discovery of stable materials by coordinate-free coarse graining
summary: Wren: Wyckoff-representation model enabling structure-agnostic stability prediction.

title: Representations of molecules and materials for interpolation of quantum-mechanical simulations via machine learning
summary: Reviews and benchmarks representations of molecules and materials for interpolation ML.

title: SISSO++: A C++ Implementation of the Sure-Independence Screening and Sparsifying Operator Approach
summary: SISSO++: C++/Python implementation of SISSO.

title: Updates to the DScribe library: New descriptors and derivatives
summary: Update of the DScribe descriptor library with new descriptors and derivatives.

title: Recent advances in the SISSO method and their implementation in the SISSO++ code
summary: Reviews recent SISSO advances and their implementation in SISSO++.

title: Equivariant Parameter Sharing for Porous Crystalline Materials
summary: Space-group-equivariant parameter sharing for property prediction of porous crystals.

title: An electrochemical series for materials
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
summary: A physical, interpretable model of oxidation states parameterized by machine learning on tens of thousands of ICSD entries yields an electrochemical series for solid-state materials and predicts oxidation states from composition more accurately than a transformer model

title: A high-performance and portable implementation of the SISSO method for CPUs and GPUs
summary: High-performance portable SISSO implementation for CPUs and GPUs.

title: A Single Architecture for Representing Invariance Under Any Space Group
summary: Proposes one architecture enforcing invariance under arbitrary space groups.

title: SLICES-PLUS: A crystal representation leveraging spatial symmetry
summary: Symmetry-augmented string crystal representation used for property prediction and design.

title: Oxidation states in solids from data-driven paradigms
summary: TOSS, a data-driven Bayesian approach that computes oxidation states for large-scale crystal datasets with high accuracy and provides labels for machine-learning alternatives

title: Towards Universal Material Property Prediction with Deep Learning and Single-Descriptor electronic Density
summary: A deep-learning framework that uses the electronic charge density as its single descriptor predicts eight material properties (R2 up to 0.94), with accuracy improving as more properties are learned jointly

title: Pointwise Distance Distributions for Detecting Near-Duplicates in Large Materials Databases
summary: Applies pointwise distance distributions to detect near-duplicate crystals in materials databases.

title: ApprOxiMate: a lightweight composition-only framework for mixed oxidation state estimation
summary: A lightweight composition-only framework that estimates mixed oxidation states in multicomponent inorganic systems, as a cheap alternative to computationally intensive assignment methods for high-throughput discovery

title: Robocrystallographer: automated crystal structure text descriptions and analysis
summary: Generates human-readable text descriptions of crystal structures, later used as LLM inputs for property prediction.

title: MatSciBERT: A materials domain language model for text mining and information extraction
summary: BERT pretrained on materials-science literature, improving NER, relation and abstract classification tasks.

title: Quantifying the advantage of domain-specific pre-training on named entity recognition tasks in materials science
summary: Introduces MatBERT and quantifies gains of domain pretraining for materials NER.

title: CrysMMNet: Multimodal Representation for Crystal Property Prediction
summary: Fuses graph and Robocrystallographer text representations to improve crystal property prediction.

title: Accurate, interpretable predictions of materials properties within transformer language models
summary: Text descriptions (composition, symmetry, site geometry) fed to a literature-pretrained transformer outperformed crystal graph networks on four of five classification properties when all reference data were used.

title: Catalyst Energy Prediction with CatBERTa: Unveiling Feature Exploration Strategies through Large Language Models
summary: CatBERTa, a pretrained transformer encoder on human-readable text of initial adsorbate-catalyst structures, predicts adsorption energy with precision comparable to conventional GNNs.

title: Bayesian Optimization of Catalysis With In-Context Learning
summary: Frozen LLMs perform regression with uncertainty via in-context learning, enabling Bayesian optimization over natural-language catalyst procedures that matches or outperforms Gaussian processes on solubility and OCM benchmarks.

title: 14 examples of how LLMs can transform materials science and chemistry: a reflection on a large language model hackathon
summary: Reports 14 hackathon projects exploring diverse LLM applications in molecular and materials science, including predictive modelling.

title: DARWIN Series: Domain Specific Large Language Models for Natural Science
summary: DARWIN is a series of open-source LLMs for physics, chemistry and materials science fine-tuned on over 60,000 instruction data points generated automatically from scientific texts.

title: Crystal structure generation with autoregressive large language modeling
summary: CrystaLLM: GPT-style model trained on millions of CIFs that generates plausible crystal structures.

title: Fine-Tuned Language Models Generate Stable Inorganic Materials as Text
summary: Fine-tunes LLaMA-2 on text-encoded crystals; ~49% of sampled structures predicted metastable.

title: Leveraging large language models for predictive chemistry
summary: Fine-tuned GPT-3 on text-formatted questions matches or beats conventional ML for low-data chemistry/materials property tasks.

title: Reflections from the 2024 Large Language Model (LLM) Hackathon for Applications in Materials Science and Chemistry
summary: Summarizes 34 hackathon projects using LLMs/agents for property prediction, molecular/materials design and automation.

title: Large Language Models for Inorganic Synthesis Predictions
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
summary: Fine-tuned LLMs predicted inorganic synthesizability and precursor selection comparably to, and sometimes better than, bespoke ML models.

title: AtomGPT: Atomistic Generative Pretrained Transformer for Forward and Inverse Materials Design
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
summary: AtomGPT predicts formation energies, band gaps and superconducting Tc from chemical and structural text with accuracy comparable to GNNs, and also generates structures.

title: AlloyBERT: Alloy property prediction with large language models
summary: AlloyBERT, a RoBERTa-based model on textual alloy composition and processing descriptions, reached MSE 0.00015 (MPEA) and 0.00611 (RAYS), beating the best shallow models (0.00025 and 0.0076).

title: A Sober Look at LLMs for Material Discovery: Are They Actually Good for Bayesian Optimization Over Molecules?
summary: Using LLMs as fixed feature extractors and with parameter-efficient finetuning for Bayesian-optimization surrogates on real chemistry problems, the study tests whether LLMs genuinely help principled BO over molecules.

title: Multimodal language and graph learning of adsorption configuration in catalysis
summary: Graph-assisted self-supervised pretraining aligning a language model with GNN embeddings reduces adsorption-energy MAE by about 10% and transfers across fine-tuning datasets.

title: DARWIN 1.5: Large Language Models as Materials Science Adapted Learners
summary: DARWIN 1.5, trained on 6M materials papers and 21 experimental datasets covering 49,256 materials, predicts properties from natural language with up to 59.1% accuracy improvement over base LLaMA-7B and outperforms SOTA ML baselines on several tasks.

title: Foundational Large Language Models for Materials Research
summary: LLaMat, LLaMA continually pretrained on materials literature and crystallographic data, excels at materials NLP and information extraction, and its LLaMat-CIF variant generates stable crystals.

title: ChatMOF: an artificial intelligence system for predicting and generating metal-organic frameworks using large language models
summary: ChatMOF, a GPT-4-based agent with a toolkit and evaluator, achieves 96.9% accuracy for searching, 95.7% for property prediction and 87.5% for generating MOFs.

title: Augmenting large language models with chemistry tools
summary: ChemCrow augments GPT-4 with 18 expert tools to autonomously perform synthesis, drug discovery and materials design tasks.

title: Unified Material Transformer as Scalable Material Property Predictor
summary: A transformer with a structure tokenizer and 3D positional encoding, pretrained with BERT- and GPT-style objectives, matches or exceeds several specialized models with one architecture; its element embeddings follow known chemical trends

title: LLM-Prop: predicting the properties of crystalline materials using large language models
summary: Fine-tunes a T5 encoder on Robocrystallographer text descriptions, outperforming GNNs on band gap and volume prediction (TextEdge dataset).

title: Probing the limitations of multimodal language models for chemistry and materials research
summary: MaCBench evaluates vision-language models on materials and chemistry data extraction, experiments and interpretation tasks.

title: Large language models for material property predictions: elastic constant tensor prediction and materials design
summary: ElaTBot fine-tuned LLM predicts full elastic constant tensors and supports agent-style materials design.

title: Hybrid-LLM-GNN: integrating large language models and graph neural networks for enhanced materials property prediction
summary: Concatenates LLM text embeddings with GNN embeddings, improving accuracy across JARVIS/Materials Project property tasks.

title: Assessment of fine-tuned large language models for real-world chemistry and material science applications
summary: A multi-group benchmark of fine-tuned open-source LLMs on diverse real-world chemistry and materials tasks found fine-tuning superior to traditional ML in most cases.

title: LLaMP: Large Language Model Made Powerful for High-fidelity Materials Knowledge Retrieval
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary: LLaMP is a retrieval-augmented hierarchical ReAct agent framework that queries Materials Project data and runs atomistic simulations without fine-tuning, and is shown to mitigate intrinsic LLM bias.

title: MatterChat: A Multi-Modal LLM for Material Science
summary: MatterChat aligns a pretrained interatomic potential with a pretrained LLM via a bridging module, improving inorganic property prediction over general-purpose LLMs such as GPT-4.

title: Less can be more for predicting properties with large language models
summary: MatText study of text representations of materials, showing LLMs underuse geometric information for property prediction.

title: Accelerating materials property predictions using machine learning
summary: Kernel ridge regression with fingerprints to predict polymer-chain electronic properties.

title: Machine learning with systematic density-functional theory calculations: Application to melting temperatures of single- and binary-component solids
summary: Kernel and Gaussian process regression on DFT-derived descriptors for melting temperatures.

title: Combinatorial screening for new materials in unconstrained composition space with machine learning
summary: Composition-based ML (decision trees) screening ternary compounds for thermodynamic stability.

title: Finding Unprecedentedly Low-Thermal-Conductivity Half-Heusler Semiconductors via High-Throughput Materials Modeling
summary: Combines ML, physical insight and ab initio calculations to scan about 79,000 AFLOW half-Heusler entries, finding kappa_L spanning more than two orders of magnitude among 450 mechanically stable semiconductors and estimating kappa_L for 77 thermodynamically stable ones

subcategory: thermal conductivity: Bayesian optimization on first-principles kappa_L
title: Prediction of Low-Thermal-Conductivity Compounds with First-Principles Anharmonic Lattice-Dynamics Calculations and Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization seeded with first-principles anharmonic lattice-dynamics kappa_L for 101 compounds screens a 54,779-compound library and finds 221 very-low-kappa_L materials

title: A Statistical Learning Framework for Materials Science: Application to Elastic Moduli of k-nary Inorganic Polycrystalline Compounds
summary: Gradient-boosting framework predicting bulk and shear moduli of k-nary inorganic compounds from composition and structure descriptors.

title: SchNet: A continuous-filter convolutional neural network for modeling quantum interactions
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 30 (NeurIPS 2017)
summary: Continuous-filter convolutional network for modeling quantum interactions in atomistic systems.

title: High accuracy and transferability of a neural network potential through charge equilibration for calcium fluoride
summary: The charge equilibration via neural network technique (CENT) for CaF2, trained only on non-periodic clusters, reproduces PBE energetics of bulk crystalline phases at ambient and high pressure, surfaces, and phonons with deviations no larger than the LDA-vs-PBE difference.

title: Theory-Guided Data Science: A New Paradigm for Scientific Discovery from Data
venue: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering
summary: Conceptualizes theory-guided data science, with a taxonomy of ways to integrate scientific knowledge into data science models across disciplines including materials discovery.

title: Effective mass and Fermi surface complexity factor from ab initio band structure calculations
summary: Boltzmann transport on ab initio band structures yields Seebeck- and conductivity-derived effective masses whose ratio defines a Fermi-surface complexity factor N_v*K* (valley degeneracy times anisotropy), which is high in good thermoelectrics such as PbTe and is proposed for high-throughput screening.

subcategory: ionic conductivity: structure-descriptor screening of Li conductors
title: Holistic computational structure screening of more than 12 000 candidates for solid lithium-ion conductor materials
summary: Screens more than 12,000 Li-containing Materials Project structures with stability, cost and electrochemical filters plus a logistic-regression conductivity classifier trained on experimental data using structure-only features, narrowing the space to a short list of promising solid-electrolyte candidates

title: Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks for an Accurate and Interpretable Prediction of Material Properties
summary: Crystal graph convolutional neural network learning properties directly from atom connectivity in periodic crystals.

title: SchNet – A deep learning architecture for molecules and materials
summary: Extends SchNet to periodic materials and demonstrates formation-energy prediction on Materials Project.

title: Symmetry-Adapted Machine Learning for Tensorial Properties of Atomistic Systems
summary: Symmetry-adapted Gaussian process regression (SA-GPR) for tensorial properties of atomistic systems.

title: Physical descriptor for the Gibbs energy of inorganic crystalline solids and temperature-dependent materials chemistry
summary: A SISSO-derived physical descriptor predicts the Gibbs energy of stoichiometric inorganic compounds at 300-1800 K with ~50 meV/atom resolution, applied to ~30,000 ICSD materials to build temperature-dependent phase diagrams.

title: Machine learning technique for prediction of magnetocaloric effect in La(Fe,Si/Al)13-based materials
summary: Gradient-boosted trees relate composition of La(Fe,Si/Al)13 compounds to Curie temperature and maximum magnetic entropy change with R2 of 0.87-0.96

subcategory: thermoelectrics: crystal graphs vs DFT descriptors for power factor
title: Predicting thermoelectric properties from crystal graphs and material descriptors - first application for functional materials
summary: A three-layer fully connected network on Materials Project-mined bonding and density-of-states descriptors predicts the scattering-time-independent power factor much better than CGCNN or XGBoost trained on crystal and atomic information alone.

subcategory: ionic conductivity: ML-guided DFT-MD discovery of Li conductors
title: Machine Learning-Assisted Discovery of Solid Li-Ion Conducting Materials
summary: Using the structure-based classifier to choose which of 12,000+ known compounds to simulate with DFT-MD makes the search 2.7 times more likely than random to find fast Li-ion conductors (F1 = 0.50, 3.5 times random), with at least a 44-fold higher log-average room-temperature conductivity, and the model doubles the F1 of six PhD-student experts.

title: Accelerated discovery of stable lead-free hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites via machine learning
summary: A target-driven ML band-gap model combined with DFT screened 5158 unexplored hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites to six orthorhombic lead-free candidates with suitable band gaps and room-temperature thermal stability, two of which have direct visible-range gaps and good environmental stability.

title: Machine-Learning-Assisted Accurate Band Gap Predictions of Functionalized MXene
summary: Kernel ridge, support vector, Gaussian process and bagging regressors using simple elemental and structural features (boiling and melting points, atomic radii, phases, bond lengths), without the PBE gap as input, predict band gaps of functionalized MXenes, with the Gaussian process model reaching the lowest RMSE of 0.14 eV.

title: Graph Networks as a Universal Machine Learning Framework for Molecules and Crystals
summary: MatErials Graph Network with global state attributes for molecules and crystals property prediction.

title: Unifying machine learning and quantum chemistry with a deep neural network for molecular wavefunctions
summary: SchNOrb deep network predicting molecular wavefunctions in local atomic orbital bases.

title: Incorporating long-range physics in atomic-scale machine learning
summary: Introduces nonlocal, O(3)-equivariant long-distance representations with the asymptotics of the electrostatic potential (LODE), capturing long-range electrostatic energies of point charges, charged dimer binding curves and the dielectric response of water, outperforming local ML schemes.

title: Physically informed artificial neural networks for atomistic modeling of materials
summary: The physically informed neural network (PINN) potential combines an analytical bond-order potential with NN regression of its parameters, demonstrated with a general-purpose potential for Al.

title: Machine learning materials physics: Integrable deep neural networks enable scale bridging by learning free energy functions
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
summary: An Integrable Deep Neural Network (IDNN) is trained on derivative (chemical potential) data of a B2-ordering binary alloy and analytically integrated to a thermodynamically consistent free energy, which in phase-field simulation correctly forms antiphase boundaries where a B-spline fit fails.

title: Embedding domain knowledge for machine learning of complex material systems
summary: Reviews strategies for embedding materials domain knowledge into ML algorithms, with examples of implementation and the materials systems to which they were applied.

title: Reliable and explainable machine-learning methods for accelerated material discovery
summary: Shows that on imbalanced materials data, standard metrics and model confidence scores mislead and that introspection with simpler surrogate models costs predictive performance; proposes an ensemble of simple models with transfer learning, a trust score and a rationale generator for crystalline-compound and solar-cell screening.

title: Predicting the Curie temperature of ferromagnets using machine learning
summary: Composition-only models trained on about 2,500 experimental ferromagnets predict TC to about 50 K accuracy and extrapolate along binary composition lines and across the Al-Co-Fe ternary.

title: Accessing thermal conductivity of complex compounds by machine learning interatomic potentials
summary: Actively learned moment tensor potentials trained on a few hundred DFT calculations reproduce the phonon spectrum and the BTE and Green-Kubo lattice thermal conductivity of the complex skutterudite CoSb3

title: Coupling the High-Throughput Property Map to Machine Learning for Predicting Lattice Thermal Conductivity
summary: High-throughput ab initio kappa_L for 120 stable nonmetallic compounds identifies four descriptors (maximum phonon frequency, integrated Grueneisen parameter up to 3 THz, average mass, cell volume), and a GPR model on them predicts log kappa_L with RMSE of about 0.21 while the Slack model strongly overestimates it

subcategory: thermal conductivity: Matminer-descriptor GPR on experimental kappa_L
title: Machine learning models for the lattice thermal conductivity prediction of inorganic materials
summary: Gaussian process regression on 61 Matminer elemental, structural and valence-electron features, reduced by recursive feature elimination, predicts experimentally measured kappa_L for about 100 inorganic compounds (81 binary, 19 ternary) and is compared with earlier theoretical models

subcategory: ionic conductivity: transfer learning for small-data Li-conductor screening
title: Screening billions of candidates for solid lithium-ion conductors: A transfer learning approach for small data
summary: Shows that generic descriptors fail on the small experimental Li-conductivity dataset unless guided by physics, and transfers the physics-informed structural model to composition descriptors through a large model-labelled database, making it possible to screen billions of hypothetical compositions.

subcategory: ionic conductivity: unsupervised discovery of Li conductors
title: Unsupervised discovery of solid-state lithium ion conductors
summary: Uses unsupervised learning on Li-containing structures, guided by only a limited amount of conductivity data, to prioritize candidates for accurate screening, then confirms 16 new fast Li conductors with 1e-4 to 1e-1 S/cm predicted by ab initio MD.

title: Accelerated Discovery of Efficient Solar Cell Materials Using Quantum and Machine-Learning Methods
summary: TBmBJ SLME calculations for 5097 non-metallic JARVIS-DFT materials identified 1997 candidates above 10% SLME (934 also stable with suitable effective masses), and an ML classifier trained on these data pre-screened over a million materials for efficient solar absorbers.

title: Developing an improved crystal graph convolutional neural network framework for accelerated materials discovery
summary: Improves CGCNN with Voronoi-tessellation neighbors and three-body explicit interactions for stability prediction.

title: Graph convolutional neural networks with global attention for improved materials property prediction
summary: Graph attention network with global attention pooling (GATGNN) for crystal property prediction.

title: Directional Message Passing for Molecular Graphs
summary: Directional message passing network embedding interatomic distances and angles (DimeNet).

subcategory: semi-supervised and PU learning: positive-unlabeled learning
title: Structure-Based Synthesizability Prediction of Crystals Using Partially Supervised Learning
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
summary: Structure-based crystal-likeness score from positive-unlabeled learning with graph networks, trained on known synthesized crystals and hypothetical structures treated as unlabeled

title: Simple descriptor derived from symbolic regression accelerating the discovery of new perovskite catalysts
summary: Symbolic regression finds a simple descriptor (mu/t) for oxide-perovskite OER activity; guided synthesis of new perovskite catalysts with improved activity

title: OrbNet: Deep learning for quantum chemistry using symmetry-adapted atomic-orbital features
summary: OrbNet, a GNN on symmetry-adapted atomic-orbital features from semi-empirical electronic-structure calculations, predicts DFT energies of drug-like molecules within chemical accuracy at >=1000-fold lower cost (molecular, not crystalline).

title: Orbital graph convolutional neural network for material property prediction
summary: OGCNN augments crystal graph convolution with atomic orbital-interaction features and an encoder-decoder, significantly outperforming CGCNN, MBTR, SOAP and conventional regressors on crystalline property benchmarks.

title: High-throughput discovery of high Curie point two-dimensional ferromagnetic materials
summary: Automated DFT plus Heisenberg Monte Carlo computes Curie temperatures for 786 2D materials (26 above 400 K) and trains an ML model that finds further high-Curie-point candidates

title: Data-driven studies of magnetic two-dimensional materials
summary: DFT plus ML predicts magnetic order, moments and formation energies of van der Waals monolayers derived from a known 2D magnet and identifies the X site as the driver of magnetic coupling

title: Predicting novel superconducting hydrides using machine learning approaches
summary: ML models steer crystal structure searches toward hydrides that superconduct closer to ambient conditions; electron-phonon calculations on stable candidates give Tc up to 115 K for RbH12 at 50 GPa

title: Lattice Thermal Conductivity Prediction Using Symbolic Regression and Machine Learning
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry A
summary: Genetic-programming symbolic regression finds four analytical kappa_L formulae that beat the Slack formula on the authors' dataset, and shows that extrapolation to differently distributed data remains hard for both symbolic regression and ML models

subcategory: thermoelectrics: structure descriptors on BoltzTraP data
title: Data-driven discovery of 3D and 2D thermoelectric materials
summary: BoltzTraP screening of about 36,000 3D and 900 2D JARVIS-DFT materials found 2932 3D and 148 2D candidates, and gradient-boosted trees on structure-aware classical-force-field-inspired descriptors (CFID) were trained to predict n- and p-type Seebeck coefficients and power factors to pre-screen materials before further DFT.

subcategory: thermoelectrics: physical descriptors beyond constant relaxation time
title: Material Descriptors for the Discovery of Efficient Thermoelectrics
summary: Full energy- and momentum-dependent electron-phonon and ionized-impurity scattering calculations on half-Heuslers identify n_v*eps_r/(D_o^2*m_cond) (valleys, dielectric constant, conductivity mass, deformation potential) as the most useful generic descriptor of optimal power factor for screening.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: electronic dielectric constant
title: Modeling the dielectric constants of crystals using machine learning
summary: SVR and deep neural networks trained on 1,364 DFPT optical (electronic) dielectric constants predict epsilon_inf, and SHAP analysis shows they recover Clausius-Mossotti and Penn-model trends while beating those analytical models in accuracy.

subcategory: optoelectronic: impurity formation enthalpies and charge-transition levels
title: Machine-learned impurity level prediction for semiconductors: the example of Cd-based chalcogenides
summary: Regression models trained on a DFT dataset of impurities in CdTe, CdSe and CdS predict impurity formation enthalpies and charge-transition levels, transfer from the end-member compounds to mixed-anion CdX alloys, and are used to predict Fermi-level-dependent formation energies of hundreds of impurities in five chalcogenides and flag impurities that can shift the equilibrium Fermi level, agreeing well with DFT for the dominant impurities.

title: Machine Learning-Enabled Design of Point Defects in 2D Materials for Quantum and Neuromorphic Information Processing
summary: Deep transfer learning and physics-informed defect featurization combined with first-principles calculations rapidly predict key point-defect properties in 2D materials and identify over one hundred unexplored dopant defects in layered metal chalcogenides, hexagonal nitrides and metal halides as candidates for quantum emission, resistive switching and neuromorphic computing.

subcategory: optoelectronic: hybrid-functional band gap from PBE density
title: Predicting HSE band gaps from PBE charge densities via neural network functionals
summary: A single neural-network functional of the PBE charge density predicts HSE band gaps of seven materials (Si, GaAs, MoS2, Ge and Sn, Ti and Zr phosphates) under varied conditions with 172.6 meV RMSE, 34% better than linear PBE-to-HSE regression.

title: Atomistic Line Graph Neural Network for improved materials property predictions
summary: Atomistic line graph neural network that explicitly passes messages over bond angles for crystal and molecular properties.

title: Graph neural networks in TensorFlow-Keras with RaggedTensor representation (kgcnn)
summary: Keras/TensorFlow library (kgcnn) implementing graph neural networks with ragged tensors for chemistry and materials.

title: GemNet: Universal Directional Graph Neural Networks for Molecules
summary: Geometric message passing with two-hop and dihedral information (GemNet) proven universal for directional GNNs.

title: Equivariant message passing for the prediction of tensorial properties and molecular spectra
summary: Polarizable atom interaction network (PaiNN) with equivariant vector features for tensorial properties and spectra.

title: SE(3)-equivariant prediction of molecular wavefunctions and electronic densities
summary: SE(3)-equivariant network (PhiSNet) predicting wavefunctions and electronic densities.

title: Direct Prediction of Phonon Density of States With Euclidean Neural Networks
summary: Euclidean neural networks (e3nn) directly predicting phonon density of states of crystals.

title: A geometric-information-enhanced crystal graph network for predicting properties of materials
summary: Geometric-information-enhanced crystal graph network (GeoCGNN) encoding distance vectors and plane waves.

title: Predicting synthesizability of crystalline materials via deep learning
summary: Deep learning on three-dimensional crystal images to classify crystalline materials as synthesizable or not

title: A fourth-generation high-dimensional neural network potential with accurate electrostatics including non-local charge transfer
summary: Introduces a fourth-generation HDNNP that combines a charge-equilibration scheme with environment-dependent atomic electronegativities and atomic energies, correctly describing global charge distributions and long-range charge transfer that local MLPs describe incorrectly.

subcategory: magnetic properties: ordering classification and Curie temperature
title: An accelerating approach of designing ferromagnetic materials via machine learning modeling of magnetic ground state and Curie temperature
summary: Random forests on composition and structure descriptors for about 2,800 intermetallics classify FM versus AFM ground states at about 87% accuracy and regress TC at about 91% accuracy (MAE about 58 K in the preprint), with comparable accuracy when applied to Materials Project magnetic intermetallics.

title: High-dimensional neural network potentials for magnetic systems using spin-dependent atom-centered symmetry functions
summary: Spin-dependent atom-centred symmetry functions let a high-dimensional neural network potential distinguish collinear magnetic states of MnO, reproducing its magnetically distorted rhombohedral structure and giving the Neel temperature with structural fluctuations, entropy and defects included.

title: Machine Learning in Magnetic Materials
summary: Review of ML applied to DFT data to link structure and composition to magnetisation; its Materials Project analysis finds that same-composition materials can differ in magnetisation by space group, and a neural network predicts magnetisation with a standard error of 8.3e-3 muB/A^3.

title: Data-Driven Studies of the Magnetic Anisotropy of Two-Dimensional Magnetic Materials
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
summary: DFT plus ML study of magnetocrystalline anisotropy in A2B2X6 monolayers derived from Cr2Ge2Te6, identifying descriptors and the role of hybridization

title: Strong correlation between electronic bonding network and critical temperature in hydrogen-based superconductors
summary: Across more than a hundred predicted hydrogen-based superconductors, the ELF-derived networking value correlates with Tc better than previous descriptors regardless of bonding type, and combined with hydrogen fraction and the hydrogen share of the Fermi-level DOS it predicts Tc with an accuracy of about 60 K.

subcategory: superconductivity: hydride screening with a Tc model
title: High-throughput discovery of high-temperature conventional superconductors
summary: Crystal structure prediction across binary hydrides at 10-500 GPa combined with an iteratively refined Tc model built on density-of-states and Gaspari-Gyorffy inputs selects candidates for converged electron-phonon calculations, yielding 36 dynamically stable superconductors above 100 K, including NaH6 and CaH6 above 200 K at 100 GPa

title: Accelerating first-principles estimation of thermal conductivity by machine-learning interatomic potentials: A MTP/ShengBTE solution
summary: Moment tensor potentials trained on short AIMD trajectories replace DFT in computing anharmonic force constants for ShengBTE, reproducing full-DFT thermal conductivities of several bulk and 2D materials at much lower cost

subcategory: thermal conductivity: GNN and random forest on computed kappa_L
title: Charting lattice thermal conductivity for inorganic crystals and discovering rare earth chalcogenides for thermoelectrics
summary: CGCNN and random-forest models trained on about 2,700 computed kappa values predict log kappa with MAE below 0.15 and R2 above 0.85, chart kappa_L for all ordered ICSD crystals, and lead to rare-earth chalcogenide thermoelectric candidates

title: Exploring diamondlike lattice thermal conductivity crystals via feature-based transfer learning
summary: Transfers descriptors from a network pretrained on a data-rich lower-order property to a small kappa_L dataset, enabling extrapolative screening of over 60,000 compounds for diamond-like high-kappa_L crystals and identifying polarizability and van der Waals radius as anharmonicity-related descriptors

title: Bridging the gap between simulated and experimental ionic conductivities in lithium superionic conductors
summary: Moment tensor potentials trained on optB88-vdW DFT give accurate lattice parameters and reproduce experimental conductivities and activation energies for Li0.33La0.56TiO3, Li3YCl6 and Li7P3S11, and long NPT MD reveals a low-temperature crossover between two Arrhenius regimes that ab initio MD cannot reach.

title: Deep potential generation scheme and simulation protocol for the Li10GeP2S12-type superionic conductors
summary: A DP-GEN active-learning protocol builds Deep Potentials for Li10GeP2S12, Li10SiP2S12 and Li10SnP2S12 that enable MD of about 1000-atom cells from 300 to 1000 K, with size, functional, thermal-expansion and disorder effects controlled so that computed diffusivities agree well with experiment.

subcategory: ionic conductivity: MLIP-MD survey (on-the-fly sparse GP)
title: Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials: Surveying Solid Electrolytes
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
summary: Ab initio MD with on-the-fly sparse Gaussian-process potentials surveys Li diffusivity in hundreds of ternary crystals, and the expert models can be combined into transferable Li-P-S and Li-Sb-S potentials that also apply to quaternary systems such as Li-Ge-P-S.

subcategory: ionic conductivity: proton-conducting perovskite oxides (hydration descriptors)
title: Accelerated Discovery of Proton-Conducting Perovskite Oxide by Capturing Physicochemical Fundamentals of Hydration
summary: Gradient-boosting models trained on 65 thermogravimetric hydration datasets map 8,613 hypothetical perovskite oxides in physically engineered descriptor spaces and predict proton concentration versus temperature; the model nominated SrSnO3, and SrSn0.8Sc0.2O3-d was then shown experimentally to take up and conduct protons.

title: Automating crystal-structure phase mapping by combining deep learning with constraint reasoning
summary: Deep reasoning networks demix XRD patterns over a composition library using thermodynamic constraints and identified 13 phases from 307 patterns in the previously unsolved Bi-Cu-V oxide system, outperforming earlier phase-mapping algorithms.

title: Scalable deeper graph neural networks for high-performance materials property prediction
summary: Deeper global-attention GNN with differentiable group normalization and skip connections enabling very deep materials GNNs.

title: Efficient and interpretable graph network representation for angle-dependent properties applied to optical spectroscopy
summary: ALIGNN-d adds dihedral angles to line-graph representations for angle-dependent properties such as optical spectra.

title: e3nn: Euclidean Neural Networks
summary: Library for building E(3)-equivariant neural networks from irreducible representations.

title: E(3)-equivariant graph neural networks for data-efficient and accurate interatomic potentials
summary: E(3)-equivariant interatomic potential (NequIP) achieving high data efficiency.

title: MACE: Higher Order Equivariant Message Passing Neural Networks for Fast and Accurate Force Fields
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 35
summary: Higher-body-order equivariant message passing (MACE) for fast and accurate force fields.

title: Periodic Graph Transformers for Crystal Material Property Prediction
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 35
summary: Periodic graph transformer (Matformer) encoding lattice periodicity for crystal property prediction.

title: A universal graph deep learning interatomic potential for the periodic table
summary: Universal graph interatomic potential (M3GNet) with three-body interactions trained on Materials Project relaxations.

title: Towards universal neural network potential for material discovery applicable to arbitrary combination of 45 elements
summary: Preferred Potential (PFP), a universal neural network potential spanning 45 elements.

title: Deep-learning density functional theory Hamiltonian for efficient ab initio electronic-structure calculation
summary: DeepH learns the DFT Hamiltonian in localized bases with message-passing networks for electronic structure.

title: Density of states prediction for materials discovery via contrastive learning from probabilistic embeddings
summary: Mat2Spec predicts phonon and electronic DOS via contrastive learning with probabilistic embeddings.

title: Equivariant Networks for Crystal Structures
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 35
summary: Equivariant networks for crystal structures respecting space-group symmetries.

subcategory: semi-supervised and PU learning: positive-unlabeled learning
title: Perovskite synthesizability using graph neural networks
summary: Positive-unlabeled learning with graph neural networks applied to the synthesizability of perovskite compositions and structures

title: A deep potential model with long-range electrostatic interactions
summary: DPLR adds the electrostatics of Gaussian charges at ionic sites and NN-predicted Wannier centroids to the short-range Deep Potential, recovering Coulombic-tail effects missing from the standard DP model.

title: Calibrating DFT Formation Enthalpy Calculations by Multifidelity Machine Learning
summary: A multifidelity random forest using DFT values as low-fidelity input learns experimental formation enthalpies more accurately than PBE (with linear correction), PBEsol, SCAN and r2SCAN, and outperforms deep representation learning and transfer learning; it is used to recalibrate Materials Project enthalpies.

title: Explainable machine learning in materials science
summary: Entry-point review of explainable AI for materials scientists that defines what "explain" means in a materials context, surveys XAI applications (saliency, attribution, surrogate models) and lays out challenges and opportunities.

title: Interpretable and Explainable Machine Learning for Materials Science and Chemistry
summary: Account surveying interpretability and explainability techniques in materials science and chemistry that explicitly warns against inferring causation or generalization from model interpretations and calls for uncertainty estimates on explanations.

title: CrysXPP: An explainable property predictor for crystalline materials
summary: Crystal-graph model that pairs a pretrained autoencoder (CrysAE) with a learned feature selector for interpretable predictions of electronic, magnetic and elastic properties, beating baselines on seven properties and outperforming DFT when fine-tuned on small experimental datasets.

title: CrabNet for Explainable Deep Learning in Materials Science: Bridging the Gap Between Academia and Industry
summary: Shows that the composition transformer CrabNet learns property-specific element representations without extra supervision, and that its element embeddings and attention maps reveal chemical trends and expose modelling or dataset errors.

title: The Disagreement Problem in Explainable Machine Learning: A Practitioner's Perspective
summary: Across four datasets, six post hoc explanation methods (e.g. SHAP, LIME, gradient-based) and six models, popular explainers often disagree about the same prediction, and practitioners settle these disagreements with ad hoc heuristics; a domain-general warning that applies directly to SHAP and gradient attributions in materials models.

title: Machine learning magnetism classifiers from atomic coordinates
summary: A Euclidean-equivariant neural network that takes only atomic coordinates classifies magnetic order (FM/AFM/NM) with 77.8% mean accuracy and the propagation vector (zero or nonzero) with 73.6%, reaching 91% for predicting no order in structures that contain magnetic elements.

title: Magnetic Moment Tensor Potentials for collinear spin-polarized materials reproduce different magnetic states of bcc Fe
summary: Magnetic moment tensor potentials (mMTPs) add collinear magnetic moments as degrees of freedom and use a two-step coarse-grained minimisation over atomic and spin space to reproduce the vibrational and magnetic behaviour of different magnetic states of bcc Fe, including phonons and MD with fluctuating moments.

title: Machine learning predicted magnetic entropy change using chemical descriptors across a large compositional landscape
summary: Dataset of experimental magnetic entropy changes across several magnetocaloric classes; a random forest (R2 0.82) screens about 40,000 compounds for room-temperature magnetocaloric candidates

title: On-the-fly interpretable machine learning for rapid discovery of two-dimensional ferromagnets with high Curie temperature
summary: On-the-fly interpretable machine learning for rapid discovery of two-dimensional ferromagnets with high Curie temperature

title: Designing high-TC superconductors with BCS-inspired screening, density functional theory, and deep-learning
summary: Electron-phonon calculations on 1058 BCS-prescreened JARVIS materials yield 105 dynamically stable compounds with Tc >= 5 K, and ALIGNN deep-learning models trained on this database predict Tc better when the Eliashberg function is learned as an intermediate quantity than when Tc is predicted directly.

subcategory: superconductivity: symbolic regression of Tc from alpha^2F
title: Machine learning of superconducting critical temperature from Eliashberg theory
summary: SISSO symbolic regression on artificially generated alpha^2F(omega) spectra and numerical Eliashberg solutions yields a closed-form Tc formula that matches Allen-Dynes for low-Tc superconductors and substantially corrects its systematic underestimation for higher-Tc ones.

title: Piezoelectric modulus prediction using machine learning and graph neural networks
summary: Compares engineered composition and structure features with random forests, SVMs and GNNs for the scalar piezoelectric modulus, finds an SVM on crystal-structure features works best, and uses it to rank 12,680 Materials Project compounds and report the top 20 candidates.

subcategory: optoelectronic: defect formation energies and charge-transition levels
title: Universal machine learning framework for defect predictions in zinc blende semiconductors
summary: Across a chemical space of about 12,000 impurity configurations in 34 group IV, III-V and II-VI zinc blende semiconductors (10% computed with DFT), regression models using elemental, coordination-environment and host descriptors predict neutral formation energies and charge-transition levels and are used to screen impurities with lower formation energy than the dominant native defects.

title: Machine learning for impurity charge-state transition levels in semiconductors from elemental properties using multi-fidelity datasets
summary: Trained on LDA/GGA transition levels corrected by a modified band-alignment scheme (no high-fidelity values needed for training), an elemental-property model predicts impurity charge-state transition levels with 0.36 eV RMSE (0.27 eV MAE) against HSE06 values over 14 semiconductor systems, outperforming models trained only on the smaller high-fidelity set.

title: Representing individual electronic states for machine learning GW band structures of 2D materials
summary: State-specific fingerprints (ENDOME operator matrix elements and radially decomposed PDOS) from standard DFT train a gradient-boosting model on 46k G0W0 quasiparticle energies of 2D materials that predicts self-energy corrections for unseen materials with 0.14 eV MAE, reduced by a further 30% when the dielectric constant is added.

subcategory: optoelectronic: band gaps and band-edge positions beyond PBE
title: Predicting band gaps and band-edge positions of oxide perovskites using density functional theory and machine learning
summary: ML models trained on HSE06 targets correct GGA band gaps and band-edge positions of ABO3 oxide perovskites, revealing a systematic correction of about 1.5 eV (about 1 eV from lowering the valence band and 0.5 eV from raising the conduction band) and identifying the chemical and structural features that control it.

subcategory: optoelectronic: band gap, absorption and PV figure of merit (composition-based)
title: Data-driven design of novel halide perovskite alloys
summary: Composition-based neural networks trained on 229 PBE and HSE06 calculations of B-site-mixed ABX3 halide perovskites predict stability, band gap, vacancy formation energy, refractive index and absorption for 17,955 alloys, screening 574 promising photovoltaic absorbers; note that descriptors are site-averaged elemental properties of pseudo-cubic structures.

title: Learning local equivariant representations for large-scale atomistic dynamics
summary: Strictly local equivariant potential (Allegro) enabling scalable large-scale molecular dynamics.

title: EquiformerV2: Improved Equivariant Transformer for Scaling to Higher-Degree Representations
summary: Equivariant transformer scaling to higher-degree representations using eSCN convolutions.

title: Efficient Approximations of Complete Interatomic Potentials for Crystal Property Prediction
summary: Crystal GNN using efficiently approximated complete infinite-sum interatomic potentials (PotNet).

title: A foundation model for atomistic materials chemistry
summary: MACE-MP-0 foundation potential trained on MPtrj and applied across diverse materials chemistry.

title: From Molecules to Materials: Pre-training Large Generalizable Models for Atomic Property Prediction
summary: Joint multi-domain pre-training (JMP) on molecules and catalysts transferable to materials property fine-tuning.

title: General framework for E(3)-equivariant neural network representation of density functional theory Hamiltonian
summary: E(3)-equivariant network (DeepH-E3) representing DFT Hamiltonians including spin-orbit coupling.

title: Transferable equivariant graph neural networks for the Hamiltonians of molecules and solids
summary: Transferable E(3)-equivariant GNN (HamGNN) predicting tight-binding Hamiltonians of molecules and solids.

title: Forces are not Enough: Benchmark and Critical Evaluation for Machine Learning Force Fields with Molecular Simulations
summary: Shows force accuracy alone poorly predicts MD-simulation quality of ML force fields.

title: Unified graph neural network force-field for the periodic table: solid state applications
summary: ALIGNN-FF unified force field for the periodic table trained on JARVIS-DFT.

title: CrysGNN: Distilling Pre-trained Knowledge to Enhance Property Prediction for Crystalline Materials
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Pre-trained crystal GNN (CrysGNN) distilling knowledge to improve downstream property predictors.

title: An equivariant graph neural network for the elasticity tensors of all seven crystal systems
summary: MatTen equivariant GNN predicting full elasticity tensors for all seven crystal systems.

subcategory: semi-supervised and PU learning: positive-unlabeled learning
title: Predicting the synthesizability of crystalline inorganic materials from the data of known material compositions
summary: SynthNN: a deep model trained on the compositions of known materials that predicts synthesizability and is compared with expert judgement

subcategory: semi-supervised and PU learning: semi-supervised learning
title: Materials synthesizability and stability prediction using a semi-supervised teacher-student dual neural network
summary: TSDNN: a semi-supervised teacher-student dual neural network that exploits many unlabelled samples for formation-energy and synthesizability prediction

title: Ewald-based Long-Range Message Passing for Molecular Graphs
venue: Proceedings of the 40th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2023)
