summary: Ewald message passing, a Fourier-space nonlocal augmentation grounded in Ewald summation, improves energy MAEs of four baseline MPNNs by on average 10% on OC20 (periodic) and 16% on OE62, with outsized gains on structures with large long-range energy contributions.

title: Interpretable models for extrapolation in scientific machine learning
summary: Across extrapolation tasks on scientific datasets, simple interpretable linear models perform on average equivalently to black-box machine-learning models (based on the published abstract summary).

title: A Crystal-Specific Pre-Training Framework for Crystal Material Property Prediction
summary: Pretrains a periodic-invariant DimeNet++ multi-graph encoder on 817,139 OQMD structures with complementary (mutex) masks that reconstruct atom types, centroid distances and Niggli lattice parameters plus an atom-type Barlow Twins term, and is best on all 8 benchmarks (e.g. JDFT2D 38.2 vs Matformer 47.7 and Crystal Twins 44.4).

title: Equivariant Neural Operator Learning with Graphon Convolution
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 36
summary: Proposes InfGCN, an SE(3)-equivariant neural operator interpretable as graphon convolution, for predicting electron densities, outperforming prior architectures on large-scale electron-density datasets.

title: Density of States Prediction of Crystalline Materials via Prompt-guided Multi-Modal Transformer
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 36
summary: Predicts crystal DOS with a prompt-guided multimodal transformer that integrates crystal representations with energy-level information.

title: GlassNet: A multitask deep neural network for predicting many glass properties
summary: GlassNet, a multitask deep neural network trained on more than 218k glass compositions, predicts 85 properties of oxide, chalcogenide, halide and other glasses and, combined with the MYEGA equation, outperforms ViscNet on unseen viscosity data.

title: polyBERT: a chemical language model to enable fully machine-driven ultrafast polymer informatics
summary: polyBERT treats polymer SMILES as a chemical language to produce fingerprints that, with multitask learning, predict many polymer properties about two orders of magnitude faster than handcrafted-fingerprint approaches at similar accuracy.

title: Robustness of Local Predictions in Atomistic Machine Learning Models
venue: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
summary: Points out that only the global target is rigorously defined, so atom-centred contributions used for post hoc interpretation depend on training data and architecture; introduces the local prediction rigidity (LPR) metric to quantify this and gives strategies to make local predictions more robust.

title: Machine learning predictions of high-Curie-temperature materials
summary: Composition-only random forest and k-NN models trained on the two largest experimental TC datasets (over 2,500 and 3,000 entries) show systematic regression to the mean (over-predicting low-TC and under-predicting high-TC materials), and learning curves suggest that much more data or better descriptors are needed for exhaustive high-TC searches.

title: Prediction of large magnetic moment materials with graph neural networks and random forests
summary: CGCNN, MEGNet and random forests trained on Materials Project screen the ICSD for ferromagnets with large moments; magnetic properties prove intrinsically harder to predict than other DFT properties, and 15 untested large-moment candidates are proposed

title: Machine-learning approach for discovery of conventional superconductors
summary: Instead of composition-plus-pressure Tc regression, ML models trained on 584 atomic structures predict the electron-phonon parameters lambda and omega_log, from which Tc is computed, and identify two previously synthesized materials with Tc of about 10-15 K at zero pressure.

subcategory: superconductivity: generative design with ML screening
title: Inverse Design of Next-Generation Superconductors Using Data-Driven Deep Generative Models
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
summary: A crystal diffusion variational autoencoder trained on about 1000 JARVIS DFT superconductors generates 3000 structures, which pretrained ALIGNN models screen to 61 candidates for DFT validation

subcategory: thermal conductivity: SISSO symbolic regression with sensitivity analysis
title: Accelerating materials-space exploration for thermal insulators by mapping materials properties via artificial intelligence
summary: SISSO symbolic regression with sensitivity analysis gives an analytic kappa_L model from only 75 experimental values, whose most influential inputs drive a hierarchical screen of 732 materials that finds 80 ultra-insulators

title: Identification of potential solid-state Li-ion conductors with semi-supervised learning
summary: A semi-supervised ML pipeline that combines scarce conductivity labels with many unlabelled Li-containing structures ranks new solid-electrolyte candidates; it is validated experimentally by synthesizing and measuring a new superionic conductor that the model predicted.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: edge-based tensor GNN
title: A General Tensor Prediction Framework Based on Graph Neural Networks
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
summary: ETGNN writes crystal tensors as sums of invariant-GNN coefficients multiplying edge-direction projections, which gives rotational equivariance without an equivariant backbone, and predicts Born effective charges and dielectric and piezoelectric tensors on JARVIS-DFT accurately.

title: Defect graph neural networks for materials discovery in high-temperature clean-energy applications
summary: A defect graph neural network (dGNN) trained on DFT oxygen-vacancy data predicts site-resolved vacancy formation enthalpies directly from the ideal host crystal, replacing a defect-supercell relaxation per unique site, and, combined with reduction-entropy thermodynamics, screens Materials Project oxides for solar thermochemical hydrogen production.

subcategory: optoelectronic: defect energies and electronic properties in 2D materials
title: Sparse representation for machine learning the properties of defects in 2D materials
summary: A sparse representation of defect configurations in 2D lattices lets a neural network learn properties of defective 2D materials with at least a 3.7-fold drop in energy-prediction error versus state-of-the-art approaches while being about an order of magnitude more resource-efficient for training and inference.

title: Connectivity optimized nested line graph networks for crystal structures
summary: Connectivity-optimized (nested line) graph networks (coGN/coNGN) achieving state-of-the-art Matbench structure tasks.

title: Complete and Efficient Graph Transformers for Crystal Material Property Prediction
summary: SE(3)-invariant and equivariant crystal graph transformers (ComFormer) with complete crystal representations.

title: Crystalformer: Infinitely Connected Attention for Periodic Structure Encoding
summary: Transformer with infinitely connected attention over periodic structures for crystal property prediction.

title: Scalable Parallel Algorithm for Graph Neural Network Interatomic Potentials in Molecular Dynamics Simulations
venue: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
summary: Spatial-decomposition parallel algorithm for GNN potentials, introducing SevenNet.

title: MatterSim: A Deep Learning Atomistic Model Across Elements, Temperatures and Pressures
summary: Deep atomistic model (MatterSim) trained across elements, temperatures and pressures for property prediction.

title: Orb: A Fast, Scalable Neural Network Potential
summary: Fast, scalable non-equivariant neural network potential (Orb) for materials.

title: DPA-2: a large atomic model as a multi-task learner
summary: Large atomic model (DPA-2) pretrained with multi-task learning across many DFT datasets.

title: Graph Atomic Cluster Expansion for Semilocal Interactions beyond Equivariant Message Passing
summary: Graph atomic cluster expansion (GRACE) for semilocal interactions beyond equivariant message passing.

title: Virtual node graph neural network for full phonon prediction
summary: Virtual-node GNN predicting full phonon band structures, including Gamma-point and full dispersions.

title: DeepH-2: Enhancing deep-learning electronic structure via an equivariant local-coordinate transformer
summary: DeepH-2 equivariant local-coordinate transformer for deep-learning electronic structure.

title: A Space Group Symmetry Informed Network for O(3) Equivariant Crystal Tensor Prediction
summary: Space-group symmetry-informed O(3)-equivariant network (GMTNet) for crystal tensor properties such as dielectric and piezoelectric tensors.

title: Universal materials model of deep-learning density functional theory Hamiltonian
summary: Universal DeepH model of DFT Hamiltonians trained across many elements and materials.

subcategory: semi-supervised and PU learning: positive-unlabeled learning
title: Synthesizability of materials stoichiometry using semi-supervised learning
summary: Semi-supervised synthesizability prediction from stoichiometry alone, for compositions whose structures are unknown

title: Incorporating long-range electrostatics in neural network potentials via variational charge equilibration from shortsighted ingredients
summary: A variational charge-equilibration MLIP that can be trained with or without charge targets; on solid and liquid NaCl it beats a local-descriptor model in energy/force accuracy and captures the DFT long-range tail of the isolated Na-Cl dimer.

title: Machine learned environment-dependent corrections for a spds* empirical tight-binding basis
summary: MLDeltaTB is a Delta-learning scheme that predicts environment-dependent corrections to on-site empirical tight-binding parameters from ab initio band structures, reproducing experimental and ab initio electronic properties of random GaAsSb alloys.

title: A Diffusion-Based Pre-training Framework for Crystal Property Prediction
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2024)
summary: CrysDiff learns the marginal distribution of unlabeled crystal structures through a symmetry-aware (rotation, reflection, periodic translation invariant) diffusion reconstruction task, then fine-tunes toward the property-conditional distribution, and reports outperforming earlier crystal pretraining models on JARVIS-DFT properties.

subcategory: foundation models: node masking + coordinate-perturbation contrastive + physics pretext
title: Physics-Guided Dual Self-Supervised Learning for Structure-Based Material Property Prediction
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
summary: DSSL pretrains a DeeperGATGNN on unlabeled Materials Project structures with node-masking prediction, coordinate-perturbation contrastive learning and an atomic-stiffness pretext task, and improves fine-tuning on most of ten property datasets (but not all, e.g. one elastic task).

title: Graph-text contrastive learning of inorganic crystal structure toward a foundation model of inorganic materials
venue: Science and Technology of Advanced Materials: Methods
summary: CLICS contrasts crystal graphs with texts describing local environments, connectivity and symmetry, and shows that the resulting embeddings support geometric concept prediction, similar-structure search and few-shot or imbalanced structure classification.

subcategory: foundation models: masked species/atom reconstruction with GAN discriminator
title: Self-supervised generative models for crystal structures
summary: Pretrains an equivariant GNN on Materials Project structures to reconstruct masked species and atoms (with a GAN discriminator as cheap evaluator), and the pretrained model is then adapted to small property tasks and groups chemically similar elements without property labels.

title: Towards physics-informed explainable machine learning and causal models for materials research
summary: Perspective tracing the move from shallow data-driven models to graph, symbolic and invariant models, and arguing that explainable and interpretable predictions should be combined with causal learning for materials design and autonomous experiments, with case studies on functional materials.

title: Spin-dependent graph neural network potential for magnetic materials
summary: SpinGNN combines Heisenberg-edge and spin-distance-edge GNNs to fit high-order spin-lattice Hamiltonians and runs spin-lattice dynamics of BiFeO3 with over a million atoms, reproducing its AFM ground state, magnetic transition and domain-wall energetics (follow-up SpinGNN++, PRB 110, 104427, adds time-reversal equivariance and noncollinear spins with SOC).

title: Non-collinear magnetic atomic cluster expansion for iron
summary: A noncollinear magnetic atomic cluster expansion for Fe, trained on collinear and noncollinear spin-DFT data, reproduces ground-state properties of several magnetic phases as well as the magnetic and lattice excitations needed for finite-temperature behaviour and crystal defects.

title: Sampling the Materials Space for Conventional Superconducting Compounds
summary: An ML model trained on ~7000 electron-phonon calculations predicts electron-phonon and superconducting properties from structural, compositional and electronic ground-state features, screening ~200,000 near-hull metals and, after DFPT validation, identifying 541 compounds with Tc > 10 K, including LiMoN2 with predicted Tc above 38 K.

title: Searching Materials Space for Hydride Superconductors at Ambient Pressure
summary: A machine-learning-assisted electron-phonon screening of more than 150,000 compounds finds about 50 ambient-pressure hydrides with Tc above 20 K (some above 70 K), mostly slightly thermodynamically unstable and combining alkali or alkaline-earth elements with noble metals.

subcategory: superconductivity: hydride Tc under pressure (GNN + uMLFF)
title: Data-driven design of high pressure hydride superconductors using DFT and deep learning
summary: DFT Tc calculations for more than 900 hydrides at 0-500 GPa find 122 dynamically stable structures with Tc above that of MgB2 (39 K), and a GNN Tc model plus a universal ML force field for pressure-dependent relaxation are used to speed up screening.

title: On-the-fly training of polynomial machine learning potentials in computing lattice thermal conductivity
summary: Integrates on-the-fly polynomial MLIPs into a modular phono3py kappa_L workflow and tests it on 103 wurtzite, zinc-blende and rocksalt compounds, greatly reducing the DFT cost of high-throughput kappa_L calculations

title: An interpretable formula for lattice thermal conductivity of crystals
summary: An interpretable, dimensionally consistent formula based on bulk modulus, shear modulus and Grueneisen parameter predicts kappa_L with 8.97% mean relative error and is applied to 4,601 binary and 6,995 ternary Materials Project compounds, predicting high kappa_L of 101 W/mK for AlBN2

subcategory: thermoelectrics: orbital-field-matrix CNN on AMSET data
title: High-throughput thermoelectric materials screening by deep convolutional neural network with fused orbital field matrix and composition descriptors
summary: A CNN classifier on fused orbital-field-matrix and composition descriptors, trained on in-house DFT plus AMSET transport data (no constant relaxation time), screened 3465 cubic, dynamically stable OQMD semiconductors for power factor above 10 uW cm^-1 K^-2 and identified many candidates with ZT near or above 1 at 300-700 K.

subcategory: thermoelectrics: DFT-derived features for power factor
title: Machine learning based feature engineering for thermoelectric materials by design
summary: On a dataset of Materials Project-derived features paired with calculated thermoelectric power factors, an interpretable random forest beats more complex models (the abstract gives no headline metric).

subcategory: thermoelectrics: high-throughput ZT workflow with ML
title: High-Throughput Prediction of the Thermal and Electronic Transport Properties of Large Physical and Chemical Spaces Accelerated by Machine Learning: Charting the ZT of Binary Skutterudites
summary: Combines new ab initio electron and phonon transport methods with machine learning in a high-throughput framework to chart ZT across the whole binary-skutterudite family as a function of carrier concentration, grain size and temperature, for both p- and n-type.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: equivariant dielectric tensor
title: Dielectric tensor prediction for inorganic materials using latent information from preferred potential
summary: An O(3)-equivariant readout on multi-rank embeddings from a pretrained universal neural network potential predicts total, electronic and ionic dielectric tensors and, in screening of stable Materials Project compounds, flags candidates such as Cs2Ti(WO4)3 (Eg = 2.93 eV, epsilon = 180.9) and CsZrCuSe3 (anisotropy ratio 121.9).

title: Discovery of high-performance dielectric materials with machine-learning-guided search
summary: Element substitution, ML pre-screening of band gap and permittivity on a concave Pareto front, DFPT and expert triage led to the synthesis of two dielectrics, CsTaTeO6 and Bi2Zr2O7 (band gap 2.27 eV, permittivity 20.5), the authors' claimed first experimentally confirmed ML-guided multi-objective materials discovery.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: frequency-dependent dielectric function
title: Deep learning of spectra: Predicting the dielectric function of semiconductors
summary: Builds an IPA database of 9,915 frequency-dependent dielectric tensors and trains OptiMate graph attention networks that predict the dielectric function and refractive index spectra from the crystal structure alone, giving smooth, artifact-free curves.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: optical dielectric function
title: Universal Ensemble-Embedding Graph Neural Network for Direct Prediction of Optical Spectra from Crystal Structures
summary: GNNOpt, an equivariant GNN with ensemble universal atom embeddings, is trained on only 944 materials and predicts the complex dielectric function, refractive index, absorption and reflectance (Kramers-Kronig-consistent), then screens photovoltaic absorbers and high-quantum-weight materials with DFT validation.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: refractive index screening
title: High-refractive-index materials screening from machine learning and ab initio methods
summary: Uses crystal graph convolutional networks with DFPT verification to screen a large recent dataset for wide-gap, high-refractive-index materials, confirming the inverse gap-dielectric trend while finding candidates competitive with industry standards.

title: Discovery of wurtzite solid solutions with enhanced piezoelectric response using machine learning
summary: A multilevel ML, chemical-intuition and thermodynamics screening protocol over more than 3,000 ternary wurtzite solid solutions from nine base systems (AlN, GaN, ZnO and others) predicts 11 materials with improved piezoelectric response driven by electropositive dopants.

subcategory: multimodal: crystal graph + element-attribute knowledge graph
title: Material Property Prediction with Element Attribute Knowledge Graphs and Multimodal Representation Learning
summary: ESNet fuses crystal-structure features with knowledge-graph embeddings of element attributes (radius, electronegativity, ionization energy) and gives leading band-gap accuracy on the Materials Project benchmark while matching existing models on formation energy.

subcategory: multimodal: charge-density images + crystallographic text (CLIP and stacked transfer learning)
title: Transfer Learning in Materials Informatics: structure-property relationships through minimal but highly informative multimodal input
summary: Pretrained CNNs and language models are transferred to electronic charge-density profile images and crystallographic text, and CLIP and a stacked multi-modality model regress energetic and structural properties across many compositions without GNNs, probing what semantic crystallographic text adds to charge-density images.

title: High-Quality Data Enabling Universality of Band Gap Descriptor and Discovery of Photovoltaic Perovskites
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
summary: A machine-learned band-gap descriptor trained on a consistently computed high-accuracy band-gap dataset (doubly screened hybrid functional gaps validated against experiment and state-of-the-art GW) transfers across single and double, halide and oxide, and hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites; screening up to 15,659 materials found 14 unreported lead-free photovoltaic perovskites, with MASnBr3, FA2SnGeBr6, FA2InBiBr6 and Ba2InBiO6 among those standing out for direct gaps, small effective masses, low exciton binding energies and high stability.

title: Accelerating defect predictions in semiconductors using graph neural networks
summary: CGCNN, MEGNet and ALIGNN models trained on one of the largest DFT defect datasets (native defects, impurities and complexes in group IV, III-V and II-VI zinc blende semiconductors, augmented with partially optimized configurations) predict charge- and chemical-potential-dependent defect formation energies, with ALIGNN best at an RMSE of about 0.3 eV.

title: Machine-learning structural reconstructions for accelerated point defect calculations
summary: A surrogate model that learns defect reconstruction motifs in metal chalcogenide and mixed-anion crystals predicts favourable reconstructions for unseen defects in unseen compositions in 90% of cases, cutting first-principles calculations by 73%, and is applied to vacancies across CdSexTe1-x alloys.

subcategory: optoelectronic: HSE band gap and band edges (2D, C2DB)
title: Combined Machine Learning and High-Throughput Calculations Predict Heyd-Scuseria-Ernzerhof Band Gap of 2D Materials and Potential MoSi2N4 Heterostructures
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
summary: ML trained on C2DB data predicts HSE band gaps, CBM and VBM for 2176 2D materials, yielding a 3539-material HSE band-edge set used to classify 766 lattice-matched MoSi2N4/2D heterostructures by band alignment (230 type I, 244 type II, 284 type III).

title: Discovery of Stable Surfaces with Extreme Work Functions by High-Throughput Density Functional Theory and Machine Learning
summary: A DFT database of 58,332 work functions for 33,631 slabs from 3,716 bulk materials trains a random-forest model on physics-based surface features with 0.09 eV test MAE (about 10^5 times faster than DFT), identifying record-low (1.25 eV, BaMoO3 (100)-Ba-O) and record-high (9.06 eV, Ag2F (001)-F) work-function surfaces.

subcategory: optoelectronic: multi-fidelity band gap and PV efficiency (composition-based)
title: Discovering novel halide perovskite alloys using multi-fidelity machine learning and genetic algorithm
summary: Multi-fidelity random forests trained on about 800 PBE and HSE06 halide perovskite alloys plus about 100 experimental points (composition, phase and fidelity descriptors) predict experiment-level decomposition energy, band gap and PV efficiency for more than 150,000 hypothetical compounds, finding thousands with 1-2 eV gaps and >15% efficiency, and a genetic algorithm finds hundreds more.

title: Learning Smooth and Expressive Interatomic Potentials for Physical Property Prediction
summary: Smooth, expressive equivariant potential (eSEN) designed for accurate physical property prediction such as phonons and thermal conductivity.

title: A Cartesian encoding graph neural network for crystal structure property prediction: application to thermal ellipsoid estimation
summary: Cartesian-encoding GNN (CartNet) for crystal properties including anisotropic thermal ellipsoids.

title: UMA: A Family of Universal Models for Atoms
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38
summary: Mixture-of-linear-experts universal models for atoms (UMA) trained on multiple Meta datasets.

title: MatterTune: an integrated, user-friendly platform for fine-tuning atomistic foundation models to accelerate materials simulation and discovery
summary: Platform for fine-tuning atomistic foundation models (JMP, ORB, MatterSim, MACE, EqV2) on downstream property tasks.

title: Accurate piezoelectric tensor prediction with equivariant attention tensor graph neural network
summary: Equivariant attention tensor GNN for accurate piezoelectric tensor prediction.

subcategory: semi-supervised and PU learning: positive-unlabeled learning
title: Crystal synthesizability prediction using contrastive positive unlabeled learning
summary: Contrastive positive-unlabeled learning for crystal synthesizability prediction

subcategory: semi-supervised and PU learning: positive-unlabeled learning
title: SynCoTrain: a dual classifier PU-learning framework for synthesizability prediction
summary: SynCoTrain: a dual-classifier co-training positive-unlabeled framework for synthesizability prediction

title: LLM-Feynman: Leveraging Large Language Models for Universal Scientific Formula and Theory Discovery
summary: LLM-Feynman: LLM-generated candidate formulas refined by systematic optimization and self-evaluation; rediscovers most Feynman-lecture formulas and finds interpretable formulas for materials problems such as 2D synthesizability

subcategory: symbolic regression: hybrid GNN and symbolic regression
title: SA-GAT-SR: self-adaptable graph attention networks with symbolic regression for high-fidelity material property prediction
summary: SA-GAT-SR: graph attention network whose selected features are passed to symbolic regression, combining GNN accuracy with an explicit formula

title: Materials-discovery workflow guided by symbolic regression for identifying acid-stable oxides for electrocatalysis
summary: Discovery workflow guided by SISSO symbolic regression that identifies acid-stable oxides for electrocatalysis from a small set of DFT data

title: Latent Ewald summation for machine learning of long-range interactions
summary: Proposes Latent Ewald Summation (LES), which learns a hidden variable from local descriptors and applies an Ewald sum to it, eliminating unphysical predictions of short-range MLIPs (even with message passing) for charged/polar dimers, bulk water and water-vapor interfaces at about twice the cost.

title: Machine learning of charges and long-range interactions from energies and forces
summary: Benchmarks LES across charged molecules, ionic liquids, electrolytes, surface adsorption and electrolyte/solid and solid-solid interfaces, showing it recovers exact atomic charges for fixed-charge systems, infers dipoles/quadrupoles and Born-type dipole derivatives, and gives better energy/force accuracy than models trained on explicit charges.

title: Learning Pairwise Interaction for Extrapolative and Interpretable Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials with Physics-Informed Neural Network
venue: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
summary: P2Net parametrizes an analytical bond-order potential layer to decompose energy into atomic-pair contributions, giving interpretable bond analyses for reactions and improved data efficiency.

title: Joint learning equation of state surfaces with uncertainty-aware physically regularized neural networks
summary: EOSNN jointly learns multiple P-T-V-E equation-of-state surfaces from compression and ab initio data with physical-consistency regularization and uncertainty quantification, outperforming traditional and Gaussian-process EOS models.

subcategory: foundation models: masked atom types + coordinate and lattice denoising
title: A Denoising Pre-training Framework for Accelerating Novel Material Discovery
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2025)
summary: Pretrains on 380,743 unlabeled crystals to recover masked atom types, perturbed positions and perturbed lattices, and reports gains over training from scratch when fine-tuned on Materials Project and JARVIS property tasks.

subcategory: foundation models: multimodal contrastive alignment (structure, DOS, charge density, text)
title: Multimodal foundation models for material property prediction and discovery
summary: MultiMat aligns crystal structure (PotNet encoder), DOS, charge density and Robocrystallographer text for about 154,000 Materials Project materials in a CLIP-style shared latent space; the pretrained structure encoder improves on PotNet and CGCNN for bulk modulus, shear modulus, elastic tensor (about 7,000 labels) and band gap (about 10,000 labels), and supports latent-space screening.

title: Bridging text and crystal structures: literature-driven contrastive learning for materials science
summary: CLaSP contrastively aligns 406,048 COD crystal structures with the titles (and keyword captions from abstracts) of their source publications, giving embeddings that cluster by property and functionality and allow zero-shot text-query screening for property-related keywords such as superconductor, with no property labels used in pretraining.

title: Establishing Deep InfoMax as an effective self-supervised learning methodology in materials informatics
summary: Pretrains Site-Net on about 70k-89k Materials Project band-gap and formation-energy structures (Matbench) by maximizing mutual information between the crystal point set and its vector representation, and with label masking shows gains for representation learning and transfer to models trained on fewer than 10^3 labels.

subcategory: foundation models: weak labels from cheap structural fingerprints (wACSF, GMP, EAD)
title: Pre-training Graph Neural Networks with Structural Fingerprints for Materials Discovery
summary: Pretrains GNNs to regress cheaply computed atom-centered descriptors on 62,783 relaxed MP structures (no DFT labels needed), giving 15-17% mean MAE improvement over training from scratch across 11 downstream datasets (5% to 35% per dataset), comparable to force-field or denoising pretraining.

title: CrystalFramer: Rethinking the Role of Frames for SE(3)-Invariant Crystal Structure Modeling
summary: Introduces dynamic, task-adaptive frames for SE(3)-invariant crystal modeling and builds them into the Crystalformer architecture, improving property prediction over static-frame baselines.

title: ReciNet: Reciprocal Space-Aware Long-Range Modeling for Crystalline Property Prediction
summary: Builds a learnable Fourier-series representation over reciprocal lattice vectors to capture long-range interactions and pairs it with a geometric GNN for crystal property prediction on JARVIS, MP and Matbench.

title: Wyckoff Transformer: Generation of Symmetric Crystals
venue: Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2025)
summary: Introduces WyFormer, a transformer over a discrete Wyckoff-position representation conditioned on space group, used to generate symmetric crystals and (via the same representation) to predict properties.

title: Scaling Laws for Neural Material Models
summary: Fits empirical scaling laws in training data, model size (1e2 to 1e9 parameters) and compute for transformer and EquiformerV2 models predicting energies, forces and stresses on OMat24.

title: Scaling Laws of Graph Neural Networks for Atomistic Materials Modeling*
summary: Systematically varies GNN model size and dataset size for atomistic materials modeling to characterize scaling behavior.

title: ELoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation for Equivariant GNNs
summary: Proposes an equivariance-preserving low-rank adaptation (path-dependent decomposition) for SO(3)-equivariant GNN interatomic potentials, improving energy/force accuracy over full fine-tuning on rMD17 and 10 inorganic datasets.

title: Towards Fast, Specialized Machine Learning Force Fields: Distilling Foundation Models via Energy Hessians
summary: Distills large MLFF foundation models into fast specialized students by matching energy Hessians, giving large inference speedups while preserving accuracy on target systems.

title: Constrained Diffusion for Accelerated Structure Relaxation of Inorganic Solids with Point Defects
summary: Proposes a primal-dual constraint-aware diffusion model to relax point-defect structures in inorganic solids, evaluated on six Bi2Te3 defect settings.

title: Interpretable Nanoporous Materials Design with Symmetry-Aware Networks
summary: Introduces a site-resolved equivariant framework based on periodic space sampling that predicts reticular-framework properties and attributes them to local sites.

subcategory: explainability: relevance propagation for GNN potentials
title: Peering inside the black box by learning the relevance of many-body functions in neural network potentials
summary: Extends GNN layer-wise relevance propagation to decompose graph neural network potentials into n-body relevance contributions without losing accuracy; on coarse-grained methane, water and the NTL9 protein (not crystals), the recovered interactions agree with physical principles.

subcategory: explainability: feature attribution consensus on descriptor models
title: Explainable machine learning for oxygen diffusion in perovskites and pyrochlores
summary: Builds a database of experimental activation energies and uses consensus feature importance across seven models to explain them: A-site bond ionicity and O2 partial pressure dominate for perovskites, and A-site s-valence count and B-site electronegativity for pyrochlores; unexpectedly, elemental-metal averages outrank features of the constituent binary oxides.

title: Interpretable Graph Neural Networks for Classifying Structure and Magnetism in Delafossite Compounds
summary: A concept-whitening graph neural network classifies delafossite stacking and magnetic order (>80% validation accuracy) while aligning latent axes with nine physical descriptors; concept alignment reaches R2 of about 0.6 for d-shell valence-electron concepts and 0.4-0.5 for magnetic-coupling parameters.

subcategory: magnetic properties: dataset and ordering/Tc prediction
title: The northeast materials database for magnetic materials
summary: LLM-extracted experimental database of 67,573 magnetic-materials entries; models trained on it reach 90% accuracy for FM/AFM/NM classification and predict Curie (Neel) temperatures with R2 0.87 (0.83) and MAE 56 K (38 K), flagging 25 FM and 13 AFM high-temperature candidates in the Materials Project.

title: Machine learning-driven discovery of hard magnetic materials using high-throughput computation and screening
summary: ML, M3GNet relaxation of 48,000 candidates and DFT validation identify rare-earth-free FeCo-based hard magnets such as Fe6CoB2 (K1 = 1.76 MJ/m3, Ms above 1.3 T, Tc above 600 K)

title: Accelerating superconductor discovery through tempered deep learning of the electron-phonon spectral function
summary: BETE-NET, a bootstrapped ensemble of tempered equivariant GNNs trained on alpha2F for 818 materials, predicts its moments and gives Tc with an MAE of 2.1 K when site-projected phonon DOS is used as an inductive bias

title: Refining Tc Prediction in Hydrides via Symbolic‐Regression‐Enhanced Electron‐Localization‐Function‐Based Descriptors
summary: On 244 binary and ternary hydrides, the ELF networking descriptor loses accuracy with compositional complexity; a molecularity index plus symbolic regression substantially improves Tc prediction

title: Machine-learning accelerated prediction of two-dimensional conventional superconductors
summary: ML models combined with DFPT electron-phonon calculations screen over 140,000 2D compounds from Alexandria, finding 105 systems with Tc > 5 K and showing that 2D materials have stronger electron-phonon coupling but lower average phonon frequencies, and hence lower Tc, than 3D counterparts.

title: Efficient modelling of anharmonicity and quantum effects in PdCuH2 with machine learning potentials
summary: Actively learned ML interatomic potentials paired with the SSCHA cut its cost by about 96% and identify a P4/mmm PdCuH2 phase that is dynamically stable only with quantum nuclear fluctuations as the likely source of the measured ambient-pressure superconductivity (Tc up to 17 K).

title: TcESTIME: predicting high-temperature hydrogen-based superconductors
summary: TcESTIME combines a complex-network analysis of the ELF bonding network with an ML fit to estimate hydride Tc from DFT electronic properties in seconds, delivered through a web interface.

title: The maximum Tc of conventional superconductors at ambient pressure
summary: Analyses electron-phonon calculations for over 20,000 metals from ML-assisted screens, with Tc estimated by the empirical McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula: omega_log rarely exceeds 1800 K, trades off against lambda, and higher-Tc compounds are increasingly unstable; a Gaussian approximation potential enables anharmonic SSCHA phonons for Li2AgH6, identified with Li2AuH6 as near the practical ambient-pressure limit

title: Accelerated discovery of crystalline materials with record ultralow lattice thermal conductivity via a universal descriptor
summary: A descriptor using only the number of atoms in the primitive cell and the sound velocity, combined with uMLIP high-throughput workflows, screens over 25,000 materials and leads to the experimental record-low kappa of 0.15-0.16 W/mK in CsAg2I3 (170-400 K)

subcategory: thermal conductivity: GNN on bonding descriptors
title: Accelerated discovery of extreme lattice thermal conductivity by crystal graph attention networks and chemical bonding
summary: A crystal attention GNN predicts normalized -ICOHP and ICOBI bonding descriptors that correlate with kappa_L across more than 4,500 crystals, screens about 200,000 structures, and DFT validation finds 106 stable compounds below 5 W/mK and 13 above 100 W/mK

subcategory: ionic conductivity: descriptors from uMLIP energy landscapes
title: Predicting ionic conductivity in solids from the machine-learned potential energy landscape
summary: Heuristic descriptors read from a universal interatomic potential's energy landscape rank Materials Project Li compounds by expected conductivity; 8 of the top 10 are confirmed superionic at room temperature by first-principles calculations, about 50 times faster than uMLIP MD and at least 3,000 times faster than AIMD.

subcategory: ionic conductivity: lattice-dynamics descriptors for Na conductors
title: Machine-learning-assisted discovery of lattice dynamics signatures of sodium superionic conductors
summary: High-throughput phonon calculations on 3,903 Na-containing structures (921 Na superionic conductors) show a strong positive correlation between Na phonon mean-squared displacement and diffusion coefficient, and ML models built on phonon descriptors (MSD, Na VDOS centre, acoustic cutoff, low-frequency coupling) rapidly predict transport.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: equivariant dielectric tensor
title: Discovery of highly anisotropic dielectric crystals with equivariant graph neural networks
summary: An equivariant GNN trained on about 6,700 Materials Project DFPT dielectric tensors predicts the full tensor, reaches state-of-the-art accuracy on the scalar dielectric constant and is used to discover crystals with nearly isotropic connectivity but highly anisotropic dielectric response.

title: Unified differentiable learning of electric response
summary: An equivariant (Allegro-based) potential treats the electric enthalpy as a function of the applied field, so polarization, Born charges and polarizability come out as exact derivatives, reproducing alpha-SiO2 vibrational and dielectric properties and the temperature-dependent hysteresis and domain switching of ferroelectric BaTiO3.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: Born effective charges
title: Representing Born effective charges with equivariant graph convolutional neural networks
summary: An equivariant graph convolutional network with equivariant weights and descriptors outputs per-atom Born effective charge tensors directly, showing good accuracy and generalization on perovskite oxides, Li3PO4 and ZrO2.

title: A multi-modal transformer for predicting global minimum adsorption energy
summary: AdsMT uses cross-attention between catalyst-surface graphs and adsorbate feature vectors to predict the global minimum adsorption energy without enumerating binding sites, reaching MAEs of 0.09, 0.14 and 0.39 eV on three new benchmark datasets.

subcategory: multimodal: XANES + pair distribution function (feature-level fusion, random forest)
title: Interpretable multimodal machine learning analysis of X-ray absorption near-edge spectra and pair distribution functions
summary: Random forests trained on simulated XANES, PDFs and both together for transition-metal oxides show that XANES-only models usually beat PDF-only models even for structural targets (oxidation state, coordination number, bond length), and that XANES dominates when the two are combined, a direct analysis of when a second modality helps.

title: Leveraging Persistent Homology Features for Accurate Defect Formation Energy Predictions via Graph Neural Networks
summary: Adding persistent-homology features of local atomic environments, with suitable graph pooling, to GNNs (including graph transformer and equivariant networks) cuts the MAE of vacancy formation energies in oxide perovskites by 55%, removes the supercell-size convergence issue and captures defect-defect interactions in multiply substituted BaTiO3.

title: Efficient and Accurate Prediction of Double Perovskite Quasiparticle Band Gaps via Machine Learning and a Descriptor
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
summary: A multistep ML framework with an interpretable descriptor predicts quasiparticle band gaps of double perovskites with over 90% accuracy and screens 4,507 candidates to 94 lead-free structures with suitable gaps, six of which are verified as stable photocatalyst candidates.

title: A graph neural network for the era of large atomistic models
summary: Line-graph-series GNN (DPA-3) for large atomistic models with scaling behavior.

title: Revisiting the Canonicalization for Fast and Accurate Crystal Tensor Property Prediction
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
summary: GoeCTP canonicalization approach enabling fast, accurate crystal tensor property prediction.

title: Composition-Weighted Symbolic Regression for General-Purpose Property Prediction
summary: Composition-weighted symbolic regression that builds formulas from elemental features for general-purpose property prediction

title: Unveiling the Core of Materials Properties via SISSO and Sensitivity Analysis
summary: SISSO combined with sensitivity analysis to identify the key physical parameters that govern materials properties

title: Physically interpretable interatomic potentials via symbolic regression and reinforcement learning
summary: Physically interpretable interatomic potentials discovered by symbolic regression with reinforcement learning

title: Improving Reliability of Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials with Physics-Informed Pretraining
venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
summary: Pretraining MLIPs (CGCNN, M3GNet, TorchMD-NET) on embedded-atom-model labels before fine-tuning on quantum-mechanical data consistently improves accuracy and MD stability for phosphorus, silica and a Materials Project subset.

title: Self-Conditioned Denoising for Atomistic Representation Learning
summary: Backbone-agnostic denoising in which a clean-structure self-embedding conditions the denoiser, pretrained on Alex-MP-20 (about 0.6-0.7M periodic structures) and on molecular and protein sets of up to 5.2M structures; controlled for backbone and data, it beats prior SSL objectives and matches supervised force-energy pretraining on average (e.g. Matbench mp_gap 0.136 vs 0.134 eV), although most materials numbers are single-fold.

subcategory: foundation models: latent diffusion (VAE + latent flow matching)
title: Latent Diffusion Pretraining for Crystal Property Prediction
summary: A VAE encoder plus latent diffusion pretrained on 380,740 GNoME crystals de-duplicated against downstream sets improves a PDDFormer backbone by 4.26% (JARVIS-DFT) and 4.90% (MP) average MAE, beats CrysDiff and DPF under matched backbones, and helps fine-tuning on about 1,500 experimental formation energies.

subcategory: foundation models: frozen uMLIP (force-field) embeddings as features
title: Leveraging neural network interatomic potentials for a foundation model of chemistry
summary: HackNIP extracts fixed-length embeddings from pretrained universal NIPs (ORB, EquiformerV2, MACE) and trains shallow learners (MODNet, XGBoost, MLP), matching or exceeding the Matbench leaderboard on several tasks and matching or beating direct ORB fine-tuning on four of five tasks at about 10^4 samples (bulk modulus 18% better, band gap worse).

subcategory: foundation models: structure-text contrastive on LLM-generated synthetic narratives
title: Scaling multimodal materials representation learning with synthetic narratives
summary: CLaC aligns crystal graphs with text using about 126k LLM-generated, property-conditioned structure-text pairs and gets better zero-shot cross-modal alignment and retrieval than the same model trained on literature-derived text; it does not report fine-tuned property regression.

subcategory: foundation models: analysis of force-field-pretrained latent features
title: Comparing the Latent Features of Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: Uses feature reconstruction errors to compare latent features of several universal MLIPs and finds that they encode chemical space in quite different ways that depend on training data, target and protocol, and that fine-tuned uMLIPs keep a strong pretraining bias, a caution for using uMLIP embeddings as generic property descriptors.

subcategory: foundation models: frozen uMLIP (MACE) embeddings as features
title: Transfer learning on universal interatomic potential embeddings improves generalization in structure-property defect models
summary: A small MLP on frozen 256-dimensional MACE universal-potential embeddings predicts DFT oxygen-vacancy formation energies of oxides with an element-wise cross-validation MAE of 0.38 eV, versus 0.72 eV for a GNN trained from scratch and 0.51 eV for direct MACE relaxations.

subcategory: foundation models: multimodal contrastive (structure, pXRD, DOS, text)
title: MatBind: a shared embedding space for multimodal materials characterization
summary: Anchors simulated pXRD, total DOS and Robocrystallographer text to crystal structure for about 155k Materials Project materials, giving emergent zero-shot cross-modal retrieval and an embedding space organized by physical properties without supervision; it reports retrieval, not fine-tuned property regression.

subcategory: foundation models: denoising autoencoder + contrastive atom embeddings
title: UNATE: UNsupervised ATomic Embedding for crystal structures property prediction
summary: Learns atom embeddings from about 139,000 unlabeled crystal graphs with a denoising autoencoder plus contrastive learning; replacing raw atomic numbers with these embeddings gives a 2.7% improvement with full data and up to 10% with 25% of the labels.

title: Are Scaling Laws of Universal MLIPs Universal?
summary: Studies data scaling of M3GNet, MACE and PET on subsets of a MatPES/MP-ALOE pool and compares random, stratified, DIRECT and furthest-point sampling policies.

title: Robust and Interpretable Adaptation of Equivariant Materials Foundation Models via Sparsity-promoting Fine-tuning
summary: Proposes sparsity-promoting fine-tuning that selectively updates parameters of E(3)-equivariant materials foundation models, matching or surpassing full fine-tuning on molecular and crystalline benchmarks.

title: PFT: Phonon Fine-tuning for Machine Learned Interatomic Potentials
summary: Introduces phonon fine-tuning, which supervises MLIP energy Hessians against DFT force constants via stochastic Hessian-vector products to improve vibrational and thermal property prediction.

title: Global Plane Waves From Local Gaussians: Periodic Charge Densities in a Blink
summary: Introduces ELECTRAFI, which builds anisotropic real-space Gaussians and evaluates plane-wave coefficients analytically to reconstruct periodic charge densities with one inverse FFT.

title: Deep Scientific Reasoning under Physical Constraints: Structure-Aware Spectrum Prediction
summary: Introduces DeepSciReasoner, which predicts electronic DOS with structure-aware spectrum decoding and constraint-preserving physical reasoning.

title: Teaching Molecular Dynamics to a Non-Autoregressive Ionic Transport Predictor
summary: Proposes a non-autoregressive ionic-transport predictor that is taught by molecular-dynamics trajectories while predicting transport properties from static structures.

subcategory: explainability: critique (architecture dependence; validation against physics)
title: Can end-to-end learning from raw electronic structure explain magnetic anisotropy?
summary: A GRU and a 1D CNN trained to predict magnetic anisotropy energy from spin- and orbital-resolved DOS reach similar in-domain accuracy but learn only partly overlapping dependencies; their shared SHAP features match spin-orbit pathways from second-order perturbation theory, yet controlled spectral perturbations show that similar attribution patterns do not imply the same functional dependence.

title: Learning magnetic order classification from large-scale materials databases
summary: Classifiers trained on experimental MAGNDATA labels with simple Materials Project descriptors exceed 92% accuracy for zero versus nonzero propagation vectors and expose a systematic ferromagnetic bias in Materials Project labels for more than 6,840 materials; LightGBM and XGBoost trained on MP labels reach only 82-85% accuracy (macro-F1 63-66%).

title: Universal Magnetic Structure Prediction from Atomic Coordinates with Near-Experimental Accuracy
summary: The magnetic structure network (MSN), an E(3)-equivariant GNN trained on experimental MAGNDATA structures, predicts collinear and noncollinear magnetic structures from crystal structure alone; a primitive modulated structure representation encodes commensurate and incommensurate orders in one framework, and the authors report high-fidelity reconstruction of experimental magnetic structures.

subcategory: magnetic properties: magnetocrystalline anisotropy and local moments
title: Accurate screening of functional materials with machine-learning potential and transfer-learned regressions: Heusler alloy benchmark
summary: ML high-throughput workflow for quaternary and all-d Heuslers: a universal potential (eSEN-30M-OAM) handles stability, while eSEN models fine-tuned by frozen transfer learning on the DxMag database predict local moments, magnetic stability and magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy; DFT confirms the candidates, and the paper benchmarks uMLIPs and how faithfully they predict local moments.

subcategory: magnetic properties: benchmark of MLIPs on magnetic systems
title: Can MACE Potentials Accurately Describe Magnetism and Phase Stability in Fe-Ni Alloys? A Systematic Benchmark
summary: A system-specific MACE model trained on spin-polarised SQS data (2.0 meV/atom energy and 24.3 meV/A force validation errors) beats several MACE foundation models, including Hubbard-U variants, on Fe-Ni properties, but every model wrongly predicts that the bcc-to-hcp transition pressure rises with Ni content, showing that magnetic collapse and magnetoelastic effects are not captured.

title: Broadening Hard-Magnet Discovery Beyond Symmetry Constraints via Unified Effective Anisotropy
summary: A unified effective anisotropy constant defined for all seven crystal systems enables a magnetocrystalline-anisotropy database and a two-stage classification-regression screen of Materials Project without symmetry prefiltering, recovering known hard magnets and finding rare-earth-free orthorhombic and monoclinic candidates; a fine-tuned diffusion model proposes five DFT-confirmed candidates, including TaFe3

title: DFT-based machine-learning for the rational design of magnetocaloric high-entropy alloys
summary: Minimal-supercell DFT data and physics-informed ML map the design space of magnetocaloric MM'X high-entropy alloys, reducing computational time by 40-60% and identifying magnetic-moment dispersion as a key descriptor

subcategory: superconductivity: Eliashberg spectral function and discovery workflow
title: Developing a complete AI-accelerated workflow for superconductor discovery
summary: BEE-NET predicts the Eliashberg function and Tc with 0.87 K MAE and a 99.4% true-negative rate; an AI-accelerated pipeline reduced 1.3 million candidates to 741 stable compounds with DFT Tc > 5 K, two of which were synthesized and confirmed superconducting

title: Towards the discovery of high critical magnetic field superconductors
summary: Consistent computational database of critical fields Hc, Hc1 and Hc2 for about 7300 electron-phonon superconductors from alpha2F and Eliashberg theory, enabling AI-guided design beyond Tc

title: Guided diffusion for the discovery of new superconductors
summary: DiffCSP pretrained on Alexandria and fine-tuned on 7183 superconductors with classifier-free guidance yields 773 candidates with DFT Tc > 5 K, with experimental validation

title: A chemical bonding based descriptor for predicting the role of anharmonicity induced by quantum nuclear effects in hydride superconductors
summary: Bonding descriptors from iCOBI or the bond valence function predict whether quantum nuclear effects destabilize a lattice and enhance Tc in hydride superconductors

title: Geometry‐Based Neural‐Network Prediction of Electron Localization Function Topology in Dense Hydrogen
summary: Neural network predicts the electron localization function of dense hydrogen from geometry, transferring from fluid to crystalline configurations while preserving ELF topology

title: Predictions of superconducting properties from chemical bonding interactions
summary: Perspective consolidating ELF networking-value theory and proposing a framework for Tc prediction of conventional superconductors from easily computable intermediate quantities

title: Machine learning driven exploration of hydride superconductors at ambient pressure
summary: Combining ab initio electron-phonon calculations with ML models to explore over two million hydride structures identifies more than 600 compounds with predicted Tc above 20 K, all above the convex hull (typically >100 meV/atom), with symbolic regression confirming that a large hydrogen contribution to the Fermi-level DOS marks high-Tc hydrides.

subcategory: superconductivity: electron-phonon Tc with dynamical instability
title: Machine-learning guided search for phonon-mediated superconductivity in boron and carbon compounds
summary: An iterative DFPT/Eliashberg plus ML search over 417 boron, carbon and borocarbide compounds, explicitly including dynamically unstable structures with stabilized imaginary modes, compares two ML models and predicts near-hull superconductors such as Ca5B3N6 (35 K) and TaNbC2 (28.4 K).

title: Machine learning protocol to identify pairing symmetries via quasiparticle interference imaging in Ising superconductors
summary: An ML strategy combining first-principles, tight-binding and symmetry-classified Bogoliubov-de Gennes simulations solves the QPI-to-pairing-parameter inverse problem with high accuracy for most pairing channels of monolayer NbSe2.

title: Search for thermodynamically stable ambient-pressure superconducting hydrides in the GNoME database
summary: A multistage screen combining machine learning for fast initial evaluation with ab initio Tc calculations over the thousands of 0 K-stable hydrides in GNoME finds 25 cubic hydrides with Tc above 4.2 K and a maximum of 17 K, modest but in phases likely to be experimentally accessible

subcategory: thermal conductivity: uMLIP fine-tuning for high-throughput kappa_L
title: Symmetry-Based Parameter Efficient Low-Rank Fine-Tuning for High-Throughput Calculation of Lattice Thermal Conductivity
summary: Symmetry-based few-shot LoRA fine-tuning of MatterSim 1M on a few compounds per space group (half-Heuslers, Fm-3m, spinels) cuts the mean absolute relative kappa_L error by 2-3 times compared with the non-fine-tuned model, and is 5-7 times faster than fine-tuning per compound across 100 compounds

title: Machine Learning Discovery of Record-Low Lattice Thermal Conductivity in Double Perovskites
summary: An active-learned deep MLIP (Elemental-SDNNFF) coupled to the BTE screens 9,709 cubic double perovskites (1,597 dynamically stable) and finds Cs2HgPtCl6 with a room-temperature kappa_L of 0.071 W/mK, confirmed with four-phonon DFT and DeePMD MD

title: Approaching the Limit of Intrinsic Crystalline Thermal Insulation
summary: A high-throughput workflow coupling uMLIPs with particle-like and wave-like (Wigner) phonon transport finds dozens of crystals with room-temperature kappa below 0.2 W/mK and experimentally validates CsTlI4 at 0.14 W/mK, with force-constant-based descriptors for ultralow kappa

subcategory: thermoelectrics: crystal-graph GNN for electronic transport
title: Learning thermoelectric transport from crystal structures via multiscale graph neural network
summary: A multiscale GNN that encodes crystals at global, atomic, bond and angle levels reaches state-of-the-art accuracy on electronic-transport benchmarks with good extrapolation, and with ab initio checks it identifies compounds with outstanding electronic transport (the abstract gives no headline error).

subcategory: thermoelectrics: generative inverse-design screening with ML surrogates
title: Inverse design of functional materials: a case study in thermoelectrics
summary: A CDVAE trained on MatHub-3d generated 6400 structures. M3GNet and MEGNet surrogates cut 1461 unique compositions to about 1000 stable candidates, DFT deformation-potential transport screening left 64, and phonon calculations confirmed four new dynamically stable compounds with kappa_L of 0.67-1.72 W m^-1 K^-1.

subcategory: thermoelectrics: ML interpolation of electron-phonon coupling
title: Generalized deformation potential and machine-learning approaches for electron-phonon coupling and thermoelectric transport in semiconductors
summary: Machine-learning interpolation of about 100 first-principles electron-phonon matrix elements per band and mode reproduces state-of-the-art thermoelectric transport for 2D MoS2 and agrees well with experiment, with better accuracy than a generalized deformation-potential model.

subcategory: ionic conductivity: GNN migration-barrier prediction (transfer learning)
title: Leveraging transfer learning for accurate estimation of ionic migration barriers in solids
summary: A GNN pre-trained on seven bulk properties and fine-tuned on 619 literature DFT migration barriers distinguishes different pathways within a structure and generalizes across intercalants, including multivalent ions; it beats classical ML, GNNs trained from scratch and a uMLIP (test R2 = 0.703, MAE = 0.261 eV in the preprint).

subcategory: ionic conductivity: proton conductors via fine-tuned MLIP-MD screening
title: High-throughput screening and mechanistic insights into solid acid proton conductors
summary: A two-stage screen of more than six million materials uses MLIPs fine-tuned to ab initio data to compute proton diffusion coefficients directly, identifying 27 high-performing solid-acid proton conductors (more than ten previously unexplored) and a universal O-O distance of about 2.5 Angstrom at proton transfer.

subcategory: ionic conductivity: descriptor-guided transfer learning for ion mobility
title: Decoding the chemical space of fast-ion conductors via a descriptor-guided transfer learning framework
summary: IonNet, a multichannel network combining static and statistical descriptors that works with or without crystal structures, outperforms 16 ablation variants and earlier deep models at predicting ion mobility, identifying 87 fast-ion conductors among about 4,500 stable compounds and about 63,000 prospective ones among about 5 million substituted compounds.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: ionic dielectric tensor
title: Physics-Based Factorized Machine Learning for Predicting Ionic Dielectric Tensors
summary: Factorizes the ionic dielectric tensor into equivariant-GNN Born effective charges and phonons from a pretrained ML potential, combined analytically, which substantially improves ionic-contribution accuracy and identifies 31 new high-kappa oxides from over 8,000 candidates.

title: General Learning of the Electric Response of Inorganic Materials
summary: MACE-Field couples a uniform electric field to MACE's equivariant features so that polarization, Born charges and polarizability follow by differentiating one electric-enthalpy functional, and fine-tuning the mace-mp-mh-0 foundation model gives cross-chemistry Z*, epsilon_inf and spontaneous-polarization predictions plus BaTiO3 hysteresis and alpha-quartz IR, Raman and dielectric spectra comparable to DFPT.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: frequency-dependent dielectric function
title: Screening for wide-gap, high-refractive-index materials via frequency-dependent dielectric function prediction aided by convolutional autoencoders
summary: Builds a database of about 30,000 IPA frequency-dependent dielectric functions (PBE and TASK), compresses the spectra about 50-fold with convolutional autoencoders so they are cheap to predict, and uses the models to screen for wide-gap, high-refractive-index materials.

subcategory: multimodal: crystal graph + text description (semantic-gated message passing)
title: SAGE-Net: Semantics-Augmented Geometric Encoder for Material Property Prediction
summary: SAGE-Net injects semantics from structure-derived crystallographic text descriptions directly into GNN message passing via semantic-guided gating, giving the lowest MAE on 8 of 10 JARVIS-DFT regression targets across several GNN backbones and strong synthesizability classification.

subcategory: multimodal: structure encoders + LLM (task-conditioned attention fusion)
title: Choosing the Right Representations: Task-Aware Fusion for Multimodal Materials Language Models
summary: A lightweight task-conditioned attention bridge that combines CHGNet features with intermediate Zatom-1 (and optionally UMA-S) representations for a materials LLM outperforms MatterChat with up to 47.8% lower RMSE using fewer trainable parameters and half the training time, reaching 89.61% macro-average classification accuracy with three encoders.

subcategory: multimodal: crystal graph + LLM text (late fusion)
title: Crystal Structure Based Graph Neural Network And LLM Multi-Modal Approach for Material Magnetic Ordering Prediction
summary: Fusing a crystal-structure GNN with an LLM reading text descriptions classifies magnetic ordering (non-magnetic, FM, AFM, FiM) on Materials Project, MAGNDATA and uranium compounds more accurately than either standalone model under all three fusion strategies tested.

title: CatalyticMLLM: A Graph-Text Multimodal Large Language Model for Catalytic Materials
summary: CatalyticMLLM unifies property prediction and CIF generation for catalytic materials in one graph-text multimodal LLM and outperforms decoupled predictor/generator baselines on catalytic relaxed-energy prediction and inverse design.

title: Enhancing composition-based materials property prediction by cross-modal knowledge transfer
summary: Transferring structural knowledge to composition-only models, either implicitly by pretraining chemical language models on multimodal embeddings or explicitly by generating structures for structure-aware predictors, gave state-of-the-art results in 25 of 32 LLM4Mat-Bench and MatBench tasks.

title: Physics-Aware Representation Learning on Electronic Charge Density for Materials Property Prediction
venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
summary: A 3D convolutional autoencoder compresses DFT charge densities into latent features that, combined with Magpie composition descriptors, predict bulk, Young's and shear moduli, formation energy and Debye temperature for about 6,059 compounds (R2 = 0.94, 0.88, 0.87, 0.96 and 0.89), with composition fusion improving accuracy over charge density alone.

subcategory: multimodal: XAS + EELS, multiple elements and edges
title: Revealing Local Structures through Machine-Learning-Fused Multimodal Spectroscopy
summary: ML models trained on fused multi-element, multi-edge XAS and EELS spectra of NMC cathode oxides infer local element content in quantitative agreement with experiment and detect oxygen vacancies and antisite defects, which single-mode spectra cannot.

subcategory: multimodal: literature text + numerical conditions + reaction pathways
title: A multimodal semantic learning framework for data-driven discovery of nitrate-to-ammonia electrocatalysts
summary: MatSemNet integrates text, numerical and reaction-pathway information mined from the literature to predict nitrate-reduction Faradaic efficiency better than single-modal or descriptor models, and guided rare-earth-doped Co3O4 catalysts that reached 85.5% FE and 28.3 mg h-1 cm-2 ammonia yield experimentally.

title: Can machine learning identify the next high-temperature superconductor? Examining extrapolation performance for materials discovery
summary: Introduces leave-one-cluster-out cross-validation (LOCO CV) to assess extrapolation of materials ML models to new chemistries.

title: A quantitative uncertainty metric controls error in neural network-driven chemical discovery
summary: Proposes a latent-space distance uncertainty metric for neural networks that controls error in transition-metal complex discovery, outperforming ensembles at lower cost.

title: Methods for comparing uncertainty quantifications for material property predictions
summary: Compares UQ methods for adsorption-energy prediction and proposes evaluation via accuracy, calibration, sharpness and NLL.

title: Evaluating explorative prediction power of machine learning algorithms for materials discovery using k-fold forward cross-validation
summary: Proposes k-fold forward cross-validation, sorting samples by property value to measure ability to predict beyond the training range.

title: Can machine learning find extraordinary materials?
summary: Evaluates whether regression and classification models can identify materials with property values exceeding those in the training data.

title: Machine-learned metrics for predicting the likelihood of success in materials discovery
summary: Introduces metrics (e.g., predicted fraction of improved candidates) to estimate in advance how likely an ML-guided search is to find improved materials.

title: Uncertainty Quantification Using Neural Networks for Molecular Property Prediction
venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
summary: Systematically compares ensemble, dropout, MVE and other NN UQ methods, finding no single method dominates across datasets and metrics.

subcategory: uncertainty: MC dropout for crystal GNNs
title: Uncertainty-Quantified Hybrid Machine Learning/Density Functional Theory High Throughput Screening Method for Crystals
venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
summary: CGCNN-HD adds tanh activations and dropout-based uncertainty to CGCNN formation-energy prediction, cutting DFT calculations by more than 50x in a Mg-Mn-O photoanode screen and raising discoverability of promising materials from 30% (plain CGCNN) to 68%.

title: Uncertainty quantification in molecular simulations with dropout neural network potentials
summary: Proposes dropout uncertainty neural network (DUNN) potentials, applied to carbon, that propagate energy and force uncertainty to stress and graphene phonon dispersion and flag configurations outside the training set.

title: Robust model benchmarking and bias-imbalance in data-driven materials science: a case study on MODNet
summary: Shows how dataset bias and imbalance distort benchmark error estimates and discusses robust evaluation, using MODNet as a case study.

title: Evidential Deep Learning for Guided Molecular Property Prediction and Discovery
summary: Applies deep evidential regression to property prediction, giving single-pass calibrated uncertainties used to guide discovery.

title: Calibrated uncertainty for molecular property prediction using ensembles of message passing neural networks
summary: Combines MPNN ensembles with recalibration to obtain well-calibrated predictive uncertainties for atomistic property prediction.

subcategory: uncertainty: quantile regression, direct interval models and Gaussian processes
title: Uncertainty Prediction for Machine Learning Models of Material Properties
summary: Compares quantile-loss models, direct learning of prediction intervals and Gaussian processes for per-sample prediction intervals on 12 JARVIS-DFT properties, slightly favouring direct interval modelling as easiest to fit and least prone to over- or under-estimating errors.

subcategory: uncertainty: GNN features with Gaussian-process head
title: Entropy-based active learning of graph neural network surrogate models for materials properties
summary: Couples a crystal GNN featurizer with a Gaussian-process head to give predictive variances for solid-state properties and uses them for entropy-based active learning, doubling the rate of test-error improvement relative to random sampling.

title: Calibration after bootstrap for accurate uncertainty quantification in regression models
summary: Shows bootstrap-ensemble uncertainties are miscalibrated and proposes a simple post-hoc recalibration that yields accurate error bars for materials regression.

title: Quality of uncertainty estimates from neural network potential ensembles
summary: Shows ensemble spread of NN potentials can severely underestimate true errors, especially for out-of-sample configurations.

subcategory: uncertainty: conformal prediction with latent distances
title: Robust and scalable uncertainty estimation with conformal prediction for machine-learned interatomic potentials
summary: Combines conformal prediction with latent-space distances (CP+latent) for neural network force-field energies, giving calibrated and sharp intervals under i.i.d. data that are insensitive to hyperparameters and scale to a 1-million-image training set, while degrading when the i.i.d. assumption is violated.

title: Exploiting redundancy in large materials datasets for efficient machine learning with less data
summary: Shows that large fractions of materials training sets are redundant and can be pruned with little loss of in-distribution accuracy, while OOD performance is not improved by more redundant data.

title: Materials property prediction with uncertainty quantification: A benchmark study
summary: Benchmarks ensemble, MC dropout, evidential and other UQ methods for GNN materials property prediction, including under OOD settings.

title: Quantifying the performance of machine learning models in materials discovery
summary: Argues standard error metrics poorly reflect discovery success and proposes discovery-oriented metrics based on sequential-learning simulations.

title: Single-model uncertainty quantification in neural network potentials does not consistently outperform model ensembles
summary: Compares evidential, MVE and GMM single-model UQ against ensembles for NN potentials, finding ensembles remain the most robust, especially out of domain.

subcategory: uncertainty: ensembles, MC dropout and evidential regression for CGCNN
title: Clarifying trust of materials property predictions using neural networks with distribution-specific uncertainty quantification
summary: Benchmarks k-fold ensembling, Monte Carlo dropout and evidential regression on a CGCNN predicting OC20 adsorption energies on alloys using accuracy, sharpness, dispersion, calibration and tightness, finding evidential regression competitively trustworthy at low cost and post-hoc recalibration essential for screening.

title: Fast uncertainty estimates in deep learning interatomic potentials
summary: Estimates uncertainty from a single equivariant interatomic potential with virtually no extra training or inference cost, matching deep-ensemble uncertainty quality and ensemble-driven active learning at an order-of-magnitude lower cost.

title: MD-HIT: Machine learning for material property prediction with dataset redundancy control
summary: Proposes MD-HIT, a CD-HIT-like redundancy-reduction algorithm for composition and structure datasets, showing random-split benchmarks overestimate performance.

title: Realistic material property prediction using domain adaptation based machine learning
summary: Frames OOD materials prediction with known target test sets as domain adaptation and shows DA methods improve accuracy on several realistic split scenarios.

title: Not as simple as we thought: a rigorous examination of data aggregation in materials informatics
summary: Shows that naively aggregating materials datasets from different sources does not reliably improve, and can harm, predictive performance, particularly for OOD samples.

title: Uncertainty quantification and propagation in atomistic machine learning
summary: Reviews UQ methods (ensembles, Bayesian, evidential, distance-based, conformal) and uncertainty propagation in atomistic ML.

subcategory: uncertainty: latent-distance UQ with distribution-free recalibration
title: Improved Uncertainty Estimation of Graph Neural Network Potentials Using Engineered Latent Space Distances
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
summary: Builds an OC20 relaxed-energy UQ benchmark for equivariant GNNs with distribution-free recalibration and finds engineered latent-distance methods the best-calibrated and most economical option, with sensible behaviour on out-of-training equation-of-state and adsorbate-coverage cases.

title: Uncertainty quantification by direct propagation of shallow ensembles
summary: Proposes direct propagation of shallow ensembles (multiple heads on a shared backbone trained with an NLL loss) as a low-overhead UQ scheme that propagates errors to derived quantities without correlation assumptions, benchmarked on generic and atomistic chemistry and materials tasks.

title: A prediction rigidity formalism for low-cost uncertainties in trained neural networks
summary: Derives prediction rigidities from a constrained optimization linked to Bayesian inference and a justified last-layer approximation, giving cheap post-hoc uncertainties for any pretrained neural regressor without changing the network or training, demonstrated from toy models to chemistry and meteorology.

title: Probing out-of-distribution generalization in machine learning for materials
summary: Analyzes many OOD tasks across chemistry and structure splits and finds most heuristic OOD tasks are actually covered by the training representation space, with only a few being truly challenging.

title: Known Unknowns: Out-of-Distribution Property Prediction in Materials and Molecules
summary: Applies bilinear transduction to extrapolate to property values outside the training range, improving recall of high-performing materials and molecules.

title: Out-of-Distribution Material Property Prediction Using Adversarial Learning
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
summary: Uses adversarial (domain-adversarial) learning to improve materials property prediction on out-of-distribution test sets.

title: A general approach for determining applicability domain of machine learning models
summary: Uses kernel density estimation in feature space to define model applicability domains, flagging inputs where errors and uncertainty estimates become unreliable.

title: Uncertainty quantification in graph neural networks with shallow ensembles
summary: Evaluates shallow (last-layer) ensembles as a cheap alternative to deep ensembles for GNN uncertainty in atomistic modeling.

title: P-DRUM: Post-hoc Descriptor-based Residual Uncertainty Modeling for Machine Learning Potentials
summary: Proposes a post-hoc UQ method that uses descriptors of an already-trained GNN potential to model residual errors, as a cheap alternative to ensembles.

subcategory: uncertainty: readout ensembles and quantile regression for foundation potentials
title: Uncertainty quantification for neural network potential foundation models
summary: Introduces readout ensembling (fine-tuning only readout layers of an ensemble of MACE-MP-0 copies) for epistemic uncertainty and quantile regression for aleatoric uncertainty, showing on the foundation model and fine-tuned variants that the two give distinct, complementary measures of output quality.

subcategory: uncertainty: heterogeneous ensembles of universal potentials
title: Heterogeneous ensemble enables a universal uncertainty metric for atomistic foundation models
summary: Builds an uncertainty metric U from disagreement among different pretrained uMLIPs that tracks true errors across diverse chemistries, and uses it for uncertainty-aware distillation that matches full-DFT training for W with only 4% of the DFT labels.

title: Evidential deep learning for interatomic potentials
summary: Introduces a physics-inspired evidential interatomic potential (eIP) that gives single-pass uncertainties without loss of accuracy, consistently outperforming other UQ methods across datasets and supporting active exploration of water and universal potentials.

title: Achieving robust extrapolation in materials property prediction via decoupled transfer learning
summary: Proposes a decoupled transfer-learning scheme to improve extrapolative prediction of materials properties beyond the training distribution.

title: MatUQ: a benchmark for uncertainty-aware out-of-distribution materials property prediction with graph neural networks
summary: Benchmark for uncertainty-aware OOD materials property prediction with GNNs.

title: Understanding and mitigating distribution shifts for universal machine learning interatomic potentials
summary: Diagnoses distribution shifts that degrade MLFF foundation models and proposes two test-time refinements (spectral graph rewiring of test graphs and gradient steps on an auxiliary physical prior) without ab initio labels.

title: Equivariant Covariance Tensors: Guaranteed SPD Uncertainty for Tensor-Valued Geometric Learning
summary: Introduces E(3)-equivariant prediction of full 6x6 covariance matrices with guaranteed SPD structure for rank-2 tensor-valued targets.

title: MOOD: Benchmarking Post-Hoc OOD Detection for Materials Property Prediction
summary: Benchmarks 15 post-hoc OOD detectors and 2 probes across 4 GNNs, 5 MatBench tasks and 15 compositional/structural shifts.

title: Null-Corrected Conditional Coverage in Materials Property Prediction: A Five-Dataset Replication
summary: Replicates conditional-coverage evaluation of seven interval (including conformal-style) methods across five materials datasets with a null-corrected worst-bin statistic.

title: Flexible uncertainty calibration for machine-learned interatomic potentials
