summary: Recasts conformal prediction as a parameterized optimization that learns environment-dependent quantile functions on top of MACE-MP-0, giving substantially (order-of-magnitude in the preprint) better uncertainty-error correlation on ionic crystals, catalytic surfaces and molecules and transferring calibration across exchange-correlation functionals.

subcategory: uncertainty: shallow ensembles and last-layer Laplace
title: How to Train a Shallow Ensemble
venue: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
summary: Shows that explicit NLL training of shallow ensembles calibrates better than random-initialization ensembles or last-layer Laplace, that force uncertainties need their own NLL term, and that fine-tuning from an energy-trained or Laplace-sampled ensemble keeps calibration while cutting training time by up to 96% across systems including amorphous carbon and BaTiO3.

subcategory: uncertainty: bootstrap, dropout, random-init and snapshot ensembles
title: Comparative study of ensemble-based uncertainty quantification methods for neural network interatomic potentials
summary: Compares bootstrap, dropout, random-initialization and snapshot ensembles for carbon-allotrope NN potentials in- and out-of-distribution (cold curves, phonons), finding that OOD uncertainty can plateau or even decrease as true error grows, so precision is not a reliable proxy for accuracy on system-level predictions.

subcategory: uncertainty: latent Mahalanobis extrapolation grade for foundation potentials
title: A latent-space extrapolation grade built into graph atomic cluster expansion foundation potentials
summary: Builds a calibrated per-atom Mahalanobis extrapolation grade (CALM) into GRACE foundation potentials that correlates with force errors on OMat24 and SMAX, detects structural and chemical extrapolation, and costs only percent-level extra compute.

subcategory: uncertainty: Gaussian processes, bagging and dropout BNNs for descriptor models
title: Modelling magnetic material properties with uncertainty-aware neural networks
summary: Benchmarks Gaussian process regression, random-forest bagging and dropout Bayesian NNs on Curie-temperature and Nd2Fe14B intrinsic-property data, showing that calibration, sharpness and confidence-curve diagnostics separate methods that look equivalent on point-error metrics, and extends the approach to GNN coercivity prediction.

title: ElemNet: Deep Learning the Chemistry of Materials From Only Elemental Composition
summary: Deep network that learns from raw elemental fractions to predict formation enthalpy without hand-crafted features.

title: Learning atoms for materials discovery
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
summary: Atom2Vec: learns atom vectors from database co-occurrence statistics.

title: Unsupervised word embeddings capture latent knowledge from materials science literature

title: Compositionally restricted attention-based network for materials property predictions
summary: CrabNet: transformer attention over element embeddings with fractional encoding for composition-based prediction.

title: Predicting thermoelectric properties from chemical formula with explicitly identifying dopant effects
summary: DopNet embeds host materials and dopants separately and predicts experimentally measured thermoelectric properties, reaching an MAE of 0.06 in ZT and extrapolating better to unknown materials than existing methods

title: Distributed representations of atoms and materials for machine learning

title: Formula Graph Self‐Attention Network for Representation‐Domain Independent Materials Discovery
summary: Formula graph self-attention network for composition-based and structure-based prediction.

title: Graph Contrastive Learning for Materials
summary: Applies graph contrastive pretraining to crystal graph networks for property prediction.

title: Composition Based Oxidation State Prediction of Materials Using Deep Learning Language Models
summary: BERTOS, a BERT transformer that predicts the oxidation states of all elements from composition alone, reaching 96.82% accuracy on cleaned ICSD data and 97.61% on oxides, and used to screen hypothetical compositions

title: Lattice Lingo: Effect of Textual Detail on Multimodal Learning for Property Prediction of Crystals
summary: Studies how textual detail affects multimodal structure-text learning for crystal properties.

title: Self-supervised learning for crystal property prediction via denoising
summary: Self-supervised denoising pretraining of crystal models for property prediction.

title: Regression with Large Language Models for Materials and Molecular Property Prediction
summary: Studies LLM-based regression for materials and molecular property prediction.

title: Leveraging language representation for materials exploration and discovery
summary: Uses language-model embeddings of materials for recall and ranking in materials discovery.

title: CAST: Cross Attention based multimodal fusion of Structure and Text for materials property prediction
summary: Cross-attention fusion of graph-based structure and text embeddings for property prediction.

title: Supervised pretraining for material property prediction
summary: Pretrains crystal GNNs with surrogate labels as an alternative to purely self-supervised pretraining.

title: MatMMFuse: Multimodal fusion model for material property prediction
summary: Multimodal fusion of crystal graph and text embeddings for property prediction.

title: ZEBRA‐Prop: A Zero‐Shot Embedding‐Based Rapid and Accessible Regression Model for Materials Properties
summary: Extends LLM-Prop by regressing properties from frozen LLM embeddings of crystal text descriptions without fine-tuning.

title: CLOUD: A Scalable and Physics-Informed Foundation Model for Crystal Representation Learning
summary: Pretrains a foundation model on unlabeled crystal structures to learn transferable crystal representations for property prediction.

title: DISTAL: Distillation and Self-Supervised Pretraining for Structure-Agnostic Materials Property Prediction
summary: Dual-prior framework combining distillation and self-supervised pretraining for structure-agnostic property prediction in low-data settings.

summary: Early review of fingerprinting and ML for materials property prediction.

title: Machine learning for molecular and materials science
summary: Landmark Nature review of ML workflows, representations and opportunities for molecules and materials.

summary: Comprehensive review of ML for solid-state materials: descriptors, algorithms, stability and property prediction.

summary: Reviews data infrastructures, databases and ML in data-driven materials science.

title: Machine learning for glass science and engineering: A review
summary: Review of early progress in using machine learning to replace trial-and-error design of oxide glasses with tailored properties, framed by the Materials Genome Initiative.

summary: Mini review of materials informatics for predicting and discovering materials with desired thermal transport properties, including thermal interface and thermoelectric materials

title: Machine Learning Approaches for Thermoelectric Materials Research
summary: Reviews ML methods used in thermoelectric research, the role each method plays, and strategies for the small databases typical of thermoelectrics.

title: Opportunities and Challenges for Machine Learning in Materials Science
summary: Discusses ML opportunities, pitfalls and model assessment in materials science.

venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
summary: Perspective on ML for materials understanding and design, emphasizing data and representations.

summary: Tutorial-style overview of the machine-learning workflow for predicting materials properties, written for chemists and materials scientists new to ML, with examples and practical questions for each stage

title: Machine-learned potentials for next-generation matter simulations
summary: Review of machine-learned interatomic potentials and their role in property simulation.

title: Polymer informatics: Current status and critical next steps
venue: Materials Science and Engineering: R: Reports
summary: Ramprasad-group review of the polymer informatics ecosystem (surrogate property models, fingerprinting, synthesizability and inverse design), highlighting the scarcity of curated data and of representations that capture processing and synthesis.

title: Ab Initio Machine Learning in Chemical Compound Space
summary: Review of quantum-mechanics-based machine learning (QML) in chemical compound space, combining the efficiency of statistical surrogate models with an ab initio view of matter to reach universality and transferability

title: Machine learning for predicting thermal transport properties of solids
venue: Materials Science and Engineering: R: Reports
summary: Reviews ML for thermal transport in solids, covering MLIPs for phonon transport in defective, amorphous and high-temperature systems, ML correlations between kappa and other properties for high-throughput screening, and ML-driven structural design for target conductance

title: Recent advances and applications of deep learning methods in materials science
summary: Review of deep learning for atomistic, image, spectral and text data in materials science.

summary: Review of GNN architectures, datasets and benchmarks for materials and chemistry property prediction.

title: The 2021 room-temperature superconductivity roadmap
summary: Community roadmap collecting viewpoints from leading groups on the status of and long-term theoretical and experimental challenges toward ambient-temperature superconductivity; notes that current design is dominated by conventional phonon-mediated superconductors while ambient-temperature superconductivity may require other pairing mechanisms

title: Machine learning for materials science: Barriers to broader adoption
summary: Discusses data, validation and cultural barriers to adopting ML in materials science.

summary: Review of ML for high-entropy alloys covering ML interatomic potentials for atomistic simulation of chemically disordered alloys (phase prediction, planar defects, plasticity) and macro-scale models for lattice structure, phase formation and mechanical properties, with uncertainty quantification and inverse design as open directions.

title: Machine-learning atomic simulation for heterogeneous catalysis
summary: Review of atomic simulation in heterogeneous catalysis and the shift toward ML potentials combined with global optimization to resolve complex surface structures and reaction networks.

title: Application of Machine Learning in Material Synthesis and Property Prediction
summary: Review outlining basic ML principles and common algorithms, and surveying their use for property prediction and synthesis guidance in areas such as superconductivity, thermoelectrics, photovoltaics, catalysis and high-entropy alloys

title: Accelerating the prediction of stable materials with machine learning
summary: Review of machine-learning methods for accelerating the prediction of thermodynamically stable materials

summary: Mini-review of direct ML prediction of kappa_L from descriptors and indirect prediction through MLIP-accelerated MD and first-principles calculations, with perspectives on data and model limitations

summary: Review of ML prediction of materials properties from chemical composition with a focus on physics-guided ML, covering statistical learning, feature reduction, composition representations, prediction of structure and electronic properties, and resource tables of databases, tools and predictors

summary: Minireview of how ML assists each stage of the superhydride discovery cycle (structure search, stability, Tc estimation), with emphasis on ternary and higher hydrides and open challenges.

summary: Practical guide to MLIPs including universal potentials, datasets and benchmarking.

summary: Review of crystal structure prediction and crystal property prediction together, tracing the transition from classical optimization algorithms to supervised and unsupervised ML, with ML modeling of crystal defects and case studies

summary: Perspective on foundation models, including LLMs, for materials discovery, covering property prediction, synthesis planning and molecular generation, and how new data capture methods and modalities will shape the field

summary: Review of ML-based materials inverse design, analysing exploration-based, model-based and optimization-based methods and their applications to alloys, optical and acoustic materials

summary: Review of AI-driven inverse materials design, from experiment- and theory-driven discovery and high-throughput electronic-structure methods to recent AI generative and design approaches

summary: Review of machine-learning strategies for small sample sizes in materials science

title: Machine learning for perovskite solar cells: a comprehensive review on opportunities and challenges for materials scientists
summary: Review of recent advances, opportunities and challenges of machine learning for materials scientists working on perovskite solar cells, including prediction of their materials and device properties

title: AI-Driven Defect Engineering for Advanced Thermoelectric Materials
summary: Review of AI and ML for thermoelectric design in a multiscale defect space, covering deep, graph and transformer models with high-throughput simulations, AI-enhanced defect engineering (composition, entropy, dislocation and grain-boundary design) and inverse design

title: Machine learning-enabled optoelectronic material discovery: a comprehensive review
summary: Review of ML combined with high-throughput screening for optoelectronic materials, predicting electronic structure, thermodynamic stability and charge transport, covering workflows, data integration and model frameworks, and challenges in data standardization, interpretability and closed-loop validation

title: Application of machine learning in magnetocaloric materials: A review
summary: Review of machine-learning applications in magnetocaloric materials

title: A review of machine learning approaches for the discovery of thermoelectric materials
summary: Reviews ML for thermoelectric discovery from experimental, crystallographic and DFT data, covering property prediction (including ZT), descriptor engineering and structural optimization, with an emphasis on earth-abundant alternatives.

title: A Survey of AI for Materials Science: Foundation Models, LLM Agents, Datasets, and Tools
summary: Survey of foundation models, LLM agents, datasets and tools for materials science including property prediction.

title: Foundation models for atomistic simulation of chemistry and materials
summary: Review of atomistic foundation models (universal MLIPs, pretraining datasets) and their evaluation.

title: A Comprehensive Review of the Computational Approaches for Structure–Property Prediction of High Entropy Materials
summary: Review of computational approaches for structure-property prediction of high-entropy materials

title: Intelligent prediction of mechanical properties in metallic materials based on machine learning: A review & perspective
summary: Systematic review and perspective on machine-learning prediction of mechanical properties of metallic materials (Advances in Mechanics 56(1):123-168)

subcategory: ionic conductivity: review of ML pipelines for solid electrolytes
title: Machine learning pipelines for the design of solid-state electrolytes
summary: Reviews ML pipelines for inorganic solid electrolytes (data, features, classical and deep models, MLIP-accelerated MD, generative design and closed-loop discovery), organized around five discovery challenges, with explicit treatment of the data gap for multivalent (Mg, Ca, Zn, Al) conductors.

subcategory: dielectric and piezoelectric: ferroelectric MLMD review
title: Polarization Dynamics in Ferroelectrics: Insights Enabled by Machine Learning Molecular Dynamics
summary: Perspective reviewing ML molecular dynamics for polarization switching, domain nucleation and migration and topological polar textures in ferroelectrics, with open problems in long-range electrostatics, multiferroic spin-lattice coupling and data-efficient pretraining of large atomistic models.

subcategory: multimodal: review of multimodal materials data (composition, microstructure, processing, characterization)
title: Generative and multimodal AI for materials prediction and design: progress, challenges, and perspectives
summary: This review introduces a property hierarchy from intrinsic to processing-dependent properties and finds that multimodal materials evidence remains concentrated in composition and idealized structure, with microstructure, processing and characterization modalities under-represented and weakly integrated.

subcategory: multimodal: review covering multimodal learning (structure, electronic, microscopy, spectroscopy, processing, text)
title: Toward automated discovery with generative models multimodal learning and closed loop workflows in inverse materials design
summary: This review of generative crystal models and closed-loop inverse design includes a survey of multimodal representations that combine crystal structure with thermodynamic and electronic data, microscopy, spectroscopy, processing context and text, and proposes a nine-rung discovery-credibility ladder with minimum reporting standards.

subcategory: uncertainty: review of uncertainty-driven active learning
title: Active Learning for Interatomic Potentials: A Review of Uncertainty-Driven Data Efficiency
summary: Reviews more than seventy 2020-2026 active-learning studies for interatomic potentials, from query-by-committee and GP force fields to foundation-model fine-tuning, and concludes that uncertainty estimates are not interchangeable across architectures and are often least reliable where they matter most.

title: Big Data Meets Quantum Chemistry Approximations: The Delta-Machine Learning Approach
venue: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
summary: Introduces Delta-learning, modeling the difference between a cheap baseline and a high-level method to reach high accuracy with little data.

title: Accelerated search for materials with targeted properties by adaptive design
summary: Uses surrogate models with uncertainty-based selection to find NiTi-based shape-memory alloys with low hysteresis from a small initial dataset.

title: A general-purpose machine learning framework for predicting properties of inorganic materials
summary: Introduces Magpie composition features with partitioned random forests, showing accurate predictions from modest datasets including experimental band gaps.

title: Multi-fidelity machine learning models for accurate bandgap predictions of solids
summary: Uses co-kriging to combine low-fidelity PBE and high-fidelity HSE band gaps for accurate predictions with fewer expensive calculations.

title: Active learning for accelerated design of layered materials
summary: Uses Gaussian-process-based Bayesian optimization to find layered heterostructures with target band gaps using few DFT calculations.

title: A strategy to apply machine learning to small datasets in materials science
summary: Shows that adding crude physical estimates as descriptors substantially improves ML accuracy on small materials datasets.

title: MT-CGCNN: Integrating Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Network with Multitask Learning for Material Property Prediction
summary: Extends CGCNN with multitask learning to jointly predict several crystal properties.

title: Enhancing materials property prediction by leveraging computational and experimental data using deep transfer learning
summary: Pretrains ElemNet on large DFT data (OQMD) and fine-tunes on small experimental formation enthalpies, achieving errors comparable to DFT-experiment discrepancy.

title: Predicting Materials Properties with Little Data Using Shotgun Transfer Learning
summary: Introduces XenonPy.MDL, a library of many pretrained models, and shows shotgun transfer from them improves predictions with very small datasets.

title: Active learning in materials science with emphasis on adaptive sampling using uncertainties for targeted design
summary: Reviews active learning and Bayesian optimization with uncertainty-driven sampling for materials design under limited data.

title: Benchmarking the acceleration of materials discovery by sequential learning
summary: Benchmarks sequential learning strategies on experimental catalyst datasets and defines acceleration and enhancement metrics.

title: Bayesian Optimization for Materials Design with Mixed Quantitative and Qualitative Variables
summary: Proposes latent-variable Gaussian process BO to handle mixed categorical and continuous materials design variables.

title: Predicting materials properties without crystal structure: deep representation learning from stoichiometry
summary: Roost learns composition representations and demonstrates transfer from OQMD to experimental band gaps, plus ensemble-based uncertainty.

title: Cross-property deep transfer learning framework for enhanced predictive analytics on small materials data
summary: Shows models pretrained on one large property dataset transfer to improve prediction of different properties on small datasets.

title: Transfer learning for materials informatics using crystal graph convolutional neural network
summary: Evaluates fine-tuning and feature-extraction transfer of CGCNN pretrained on large DFT data to small property datasets.

title: AtomSets as a hierarchical transfer learning framework for small and large materials datasets
summary: Uses pretrained MEGNet features with set-based models to achieve good accuracy on datasets ranging from hundreds to hundreds of thousands of samples.

summary: Multi-fidelity MEGNet jointly learns band gaps from PBE, GLLB-SC, HSE, SCAN and experimental data, reducing high-fidelity errors.

title: A simple denoising approach to exploit multi-fidelity data for machine learning materials properties
summary: Treats low-fidelity data as noisy high-fidelity labels and denoises them to improve band-gap prediction with scarce high-fidelity data.

title: Towards overcoming data scarcity in materials science: unifying models and datasets with a mixture of experts framework
summary: Combines multiple pretrained source models via a mixture-of-experts gating to outperform pairwise transfer learning on data-scarce tasks.

title: Crystal twins: self-supervised learning for crystalline material property prediction
summary: Pretrains CGCNN with Barlow Twins/SimSiam objectives on augmented crystals, improving downstream accuracy on small Matbench tasks.

title: Self-supervised learning of materials concepts from crystal structures via deep neural networks
summary: Learns crystal-structure embeddings self-supervised by matching structures with their XRD patterns, capturing materials similarity without labels.

title: Data-augmentation for graph neural network learning of the relaxed energies of unrelaxed structures
summary: Augments training data with perturbed structures labeled with relaxed energies so GNNs predict relaxed energies from unrelaxed inputs.

title: Benchmarking AutoML for regression tasks on small tabular data in materials design
summary: Benchmarks AutoML frameworks on small tabular materials-design regression datasets.

title: Physically Informed Machine Learning Prediction of Electronic Density of States
summary: Predicts electronic DOS with a GNN using physically informed encodings, enabling derived properties with improved data efficiency.

title: Multi-task graph neural networks for simultaneous prediction of global and atomic properties in ferromagnetic systems
summary: Multi-task GNN jointly predicting global and atomic properties of ferromagnetic alloys.

title: Curvature-informed multi-task learning for graph networks
summary: Studies curvature-informed multi-task optimization for graph networks predicting materials properties.

title: Accurate property prediction with interpretable machine learning model for small datasets via transformed atom vector

title: Transfer learning on large datasets for the accurate prediction of material properties
summary: Pretrains crystal-graph attention networks on millions of PBE calculations and fine-tunes to higher-fidelity (PBEsol, SCAN) data, reducing data needs.

title: Small data machine learning in materials science

summary: Benchmark for multi-task, multi-dataset learning on solid-state materials.

summary: Shows adaptive-readout GNN transfer from abundant low-fidelity to sparse high-fidelity data gives large gains in drug discovery and quantum mechanics tasks.

title: Pretraining Strategies for Structure Agnostic Material Property Prediction

summary: Compares self-supervised, fingerprint-supervised and multimodal pretraining for composition-only transformers, improving small-data property prediction.

title: Extrapolative prediction of small-data molecular property using quantum mechanics-assisted machine learning
summary: Uses quantum-mechanical descriptors to improve extrapolative prediction for small-data property tasks.

title: Data-efficient fine-tuning of foundational models for first-principles quality sublimation enthalpies
summary: Fine-tunes a MACE foundation model with tens of reference structures to predict molecular-crystal sublimation enthalpies at first-principles quality.

title: Materials design with target-oriented Bayesian optimization
summary: Introduces a target-oriented expected improvement acquisition for finding materials with a specific property value in few experiments.

summary: Trains CGCNN on synthetic structures generated by a conditional generative model (Con-CDVAE) and shows benefits in extremely data-scarce settings.

summary: Combines data augmentation with uncertainty-aware CGCNN for thermodynamic stability prediction.

summary: Shows multi-task fine-tuning of atomistic models improves OOD generalization.

title: Out-of-the-Box Tabular Foundation Models for Bayesian Optimization in Materials Discovery
summary: Evaluates TabPFN and TabICL as out-of-the-box surrogates for Bayesian optimization on materials benchmarks against GPs, random forests and CatBoost.
